textFields.text: Limitation brings success, but a limit that turns harsh and bitter cannot endure, so restraint must itself be kept within bounds. The image is a lake holding water: the lake can take in only so much before it spills over, and so the wise set firm measures of number and degree, weighing conduct and judging where virtue lies.
When the courtyard and its gate are closed and the moment forbids movement, hold still within your own threshold; knowing not to step out is itself the right limit, and it draws no blame.
Now the inner gate stands open and the time to go forth has plainly come, yet you delay within your rooms; to restrain yourself when action is called for is mistimed, and it brings misfortune.
One who will accept no measure and overflows every bound is left with sighing and regret; yet since the excess was freely chosen, the fault lies nowhere but with oneself, and no blame falls outside.

Limitation that settles into place with ease, resting content within what circumstance allows rather than forcing it, moves without friction and meets success; restraint costs nothing when it follows the natural shape of things.

To take the limit upon yourself willingly, and to make it sweet by bearing it before requiring it of others, brings good fortune; act first by your own example, and going forward wins honor and reward.

Restraint driven to a galling, bitter extreme cannot hold, and to cling to it invites ruin and regret; but where such severity is truly required for a season, accepting its hardship lets the regret pass away.

textFields.text: 中孚所教导的是：深藏于心的真诚，连最迟钝、最顽固的生灵也能感受到。因此，前行依靠真挚的情感，而非强力或巧辩；坚定持守，即使艰险的渡越也能展开。卦象是风行于泽上，气息触及水面之下：正如风向下渗透，有智慧的领导者会耐心审察过错，在真正了解事情的内情之前，暂缓最严厉的判决。
安定于自身，准备充分而心无旁骛，便有吉祥；但当你又暗暗把信任寄托在别的可能性上时，那份内心的安宁就会消失。
一只鸟儿从阴影中呼唤，而它那看不见的幼鸟会做出回应：真实的感觉可以跨越任何距离。你身上真实的东西会在另一个人身上引起回响，就像一杯酒变成了令人愉快地分享的东西一样。
当你把自己绑在一个掌控一切的伙伴身上后，你在敲鼓和沉默之间、在眼泪和歌声之间摇摆不定。完全从别人那里借来的快乐会让你被他们的每一种情绪所困扰。
如将满未满的月亮，你离开往日的同伴，转向更高之处；套在车辕上的马脱离马队，循自己的道路前行，仍忠于本心，因此没有过错。
真诚深厚到足以聚拢众人，使他们与你紧密相连，就不会有过错。居于中心的稳固力量值得信赖，因而维系整个群体。
公鸡啼叫，声音竭力冲向天空；喧闹与炫耀试图达到只有内在真实才能抵达的地方。若执着于空话和外在姿态，无论看起来多么端正，最终只会败坏。
中孚所教導的是：深藏於心的真誠，連最遲鈍、最頑固的生靈也能感受到。因此，前行依靠真摯的情感，而非強力或巧辯；堅定持守，即使艱險的渡越也能展開。卦象是風行於澤上，氣息觸及水面之下：正如風向下滲透，有智慧的領導者會耐心審察過錯，在真正瞭解事情的內情之前，暫緩最嚴厲的判決。
安定於自身，準備充分而心無旁騖，便有吉祥；但當你又暗暗把信任寄託在別的可能性上時，那份內心的安寧就會消失。
一隻鳥兒從陰影中呼喚，而它那看不見的幼鳥會做出回應：真實的感覺可以跨越任何距離。你身上真實的東西會在另一個人身上引起迴響，就像一杯酒變成了令人愉快地分享的東西一樣。
當你把自己綁在一個掌控一切的夥伴身上後，你在敲鼓和沉默之間、在眼淚和歌聲之間搖擺不定。完全從別人那裡借來的快樂會讓你被他們的每一種情緒所困擾。
如將滿未滿的月亮，你離開往日的同伴，轉向更高之處；套在車轅上的馬脫離馬隊，循自己的道路前行，仍忠於本心，因此沒有過錯。
真誠深厚到足以聚攏眾人，使他們與你緊密相連，就不會有過錯。居於中心的穩固力量值得信賴，因而維繫整個群體。
公雞啼叫，聲音竭力衝向天空；喧鬧與炫耀試圖達到只有內在真實才能抵達的地方。若執著於空話和外在姿態，無論看起來多麼端正，最終只會敗壞。

textFields.text: Inner Truth teaches that conviction held deep in the heart reaches even the dullest and most unyielding of creatures, so the way forward is honest feeling rather than force or clever argument; held to with steadiness, even a daunting passage may be undertaken. The Image sets moving air over still water, breath touching what lies beneath the surface: just as the wind penetrates below, the wise leader looks into wrongdoing with patient care and holds back the harshest sentence until the heart of the case is truly known.
Standing settled in yourself, ready and undivided, brings good fortune; but the moment you quietly pin your trust on some other prospect as well, that inner calm slips away.

A bird calls from the shadows and its young, unseen, answers back: real feeling carries across any distance on its own. What is true in you summons its echo in another, the way an offered cup of wine becomes something gladly shared.

Having tied yourself to a partner who holds all the strings, you lurch between beating the drum and falling silent, between tears and song. Joy taken wholly on loan from someone else leaves you tossed by their every mood.

Like the moon just short of full, step back from your former companion and turn toward what stands higher; the harness-horse that leaves the team to go its own way keeps faith with itself and earns no blame.
A truthfulness so whole that it gathers others and binds them to you as one carries no fault; the steady, trusted strength at the center keeps the whole gathering held together.
A rooster's crow strains toward the sky—noise and display reaching for what only inner truth can reach. Clinging to hollow words and outward show, however upright the pose, leads only to ruin.

textFields.text: 小过卦中，小事可以通达，日常事务能成功，宏大的事业却暂不可及。坚守正道，控制规模；听飞鸟鸣叫，就知道此时下降比高飞更合宜。卦象是雷响于山上，比在平地更近、更尖锐。明智之人因此格外用心于细微职责：行为更加恭敬，哀悼更加真切，用度更加节省。
鸟儿在准备飞翔之前就展翅欲飞，爬得太远太快就会导致糟糕的结局。现在还没有达到你需要站起来的程度，所以保持在地面上。
她经过她的祖父，来到她的祖母面前。她并不抢占君主的位置，而是像仆人一样规规矩矩地迎接他。在她应有的限度内，她没有过错。
不特别提防伤害，就会留下空隙，使人从背后靠近并伤害你。在这样重视小处的时节，唯有加倍警醒才能避祸；疏忽则会招致不幸。
你不会犯任何错误：你会满足当下的要求，并且不会超出适当的范围。现在再推进是有危险的，所以要保持警惕和克制，没必要一直强求。
西边浓云飘来，却无雨来；实现你的愿望的时机尚未成熟。就像王子射出一支箭，射中了藏在洞里的鸟一样，利用隐藏的帮助，充分利用小手段。
由于未能赶上时机，他完全超越了时机，就像一只飞翔的鸟儿远远超出了它应该降落的地方。这会带来不幸——自作自受的灾难——因为在需要克制的时候超过了标准，这是最大的错误。
小過卦中，小事可以通達，日常事務能成功，宏大的事業卻暫不可及。堅守正道，控制規模；聽飛鳥鳴叫，就知道此時下降比高飛更合宜。卦象是雷響于山上，比在平地更近、更尖銳。明智之人因此格外用心於細微職責：行為更加恭敬，哀悼更加真切，用度更加節省。
鳥兒在準備飛翔之前就展翅欲飛，爬得太遠太快就會導致糟糕的結局。現在還沒有達到你需要站起來的程度，所以保持在地面上。
她經過她的祖父，來到她的祖母面前。她並不搶佔君主的位置，而是像僕人一樣規規矩矩地迎接他。在她應有的限度內，她沒有過錯。
不特別提防傷害，就會留下空隙，使人從背後靠近並傷害你。在這樣重視小處的時節，唯有加倍警醒才能避禍；疏忽則會招致不幸。
你不會犯任何錯誤：你會滿足當下的要求，並且不會超出適當的範圍。現在再推進是有危險的，所以要保持警惕和剋制，沒必要一直強求。
西邊濃雲飄來，卻無雨來；實現你的願望的時機尚未成熟。就像王子射出一支箭，射中了藏在洞裡的鳥一樣，利用隱藏的幫助，充分利用小手段。
由於未能趕上時機，他完全超越了時機，就像一隻飛翔的鳥兒遠遠超出了它應該降落的地方。這會帶來不幸——自作自受的災難——因為在需要剋制的時候超過了標準，這是最大的錯誤。

textFields.text: The small may pass and prevail now: minor, everyday affairs can succeed, but ambitious ventures are out of reach — hold to what is correct, keep your scale modest, and let the call of the flying bird teach you that it is better to come down than to climb. Thunder rings out over the mountain, sounding closer and sharper than it would on open ground; so attend to small duties with unusual care — be more deferential in your conduct, more heartfelt in mourning, more sparing in what you spend.
A bird takes wing before it is ready to fly, and climbing too far too soon ends badly. The moment does not yet hold what you would need to rise, so keep to the ground.

She goes past her grandfather and comes upon her grandmother; she makes no grab at the ruler's place but meets him properly as a servant does. Staying within her rightful measure, she is without fault.

Taking no special care against harm, you leave an opening, and someone slips up behind to wound you. In a small time like this, only added watchfulness keeps trouble away; misfortune follows the careless.
You commit no error: you meet what the moment asks and go no further than is fitting. To push ahead now would be dangerous, so stay alert and restrained — there is no need to keep forcing the matter.

Thick clouds drift in from the western edge, yet no rain comes; the time is not ripe to fulfill what you hope for. Like a prince who looses an arrow and takes the bird hiding in its hollow, draw out the help that lies concealed and make the most of small means.

Failing to meet the moment, he overshoots it entirely, like a bird that soars far past where it should have landed. This brings misfortune — a disaster of one's own making — for to exceed the mark just when restraint was called for is the gravest fault.

textFields.text: 完成后：跨越已经完成，每条线都站在适当的位置，所以剩下的就是在小事上取得成功，并保持已经赢得的东西的纪律。这一判决赞成坚定不移，但也警告说，秩序在巅峰时已经埋下了混乱的种子——一开始的好运最终可能会陷入混乱。形象就像水放在火上：一种烹饪和完成的力量，但总是接近沸腾或干涸，所以深思熟虑的人预见到事情可能会失败，并在麻烦来临之前做好准备。
他拖着轮子让车慢下来，就像狐狸在水面上湿了尾巴一样。从一开始就退缩而不是向前冲，这样你就不会受到责备。
一位女子遗失了遮护车厢的帘幕，车子暴露在外；无须急着寻找，七天之后它会自行回来。耐心等待，失去的东西自会归还。
正如旧统治者花了整整三年的时间来镇压一场遥远的叛乱一样，一场有价值的征服也让你筋疲力尽。一定要坚持下去，但决不能把来之不易的成果落到小人手里。
精美的衣服仍然带有破布来堵住渗漏的漏洞，你整天都保持警惕；即使在固定的时间里，这种对最小裂缝的警惕也能保证你的安全。
东边的邻国宰牛大祭，所得的却比西边的邻国用朴素的春祭少。真诚的付出会带来真正的祝福，而昂贵的表现则不会。
他已经渡过河，却仍继续前行，直到水没过头顶。事情完成后还强求推进，便会招致毁坏；此处的危险，在于不知道何时已经做完。

textFields.text: After Completion: the crossing is made and every line stands in its proper place, so what remains is success in small things and the discipline to hold what has been won. The judgment favors steadfastness yet warns that order at its peak already carries the seed of confusion — good fortune at the start can slide into disarray at the end. The image is water set above fire: a force that cooks and accomplishes, yet always near to boiling over or running dry, so the thoughtful person foresees where things may fail and prepares against trouble before it comes.
He drags the wheels to slow the cart, like a fox that wets its tail crossing the water; by holding back at the very beginning instead of charging ahead, you keep yourself free of blame.
A woman loses the screen that shields her carriage and is left uncovered; she need not go searching for it, for in seven days it comes back on its own — wait, and what was lost returns of itself.

As the old ruler labored three full years to put down a distant rebellion, so a worthy conquest exhausts you completely; carry it through, but never leave such hard-won gains in the hands of petty people.
Fine garments still carry rags to plug the seeping leaks, and you stay wary the whole day through; even in a settled hour, this watchfulness against the smallest cracks is what keeps you safe.

The neighbor in the east slaughters an ox in grand sacrifice, yet gains less than the neighbor in the west with a plain spring offering; sincerity simply given draws the real blessing, while costly display does not.
He has crossed over, but goes on until the water covers his head; to push past completion is to court ruin — the peril here is not knowing when the work is finished.

textFields.text: 完成之前是离彼岸不远的时刻，火势已升到水面，两种力量分崩离析——旧的秩序已经消失，新的秩序还没有建立，但仍然可以跨越。其中有成功的可能，但只有那些像一只经验丰富的狐狸在冰上试探一样行动的人才能获得成功。鲁莽的小狐狸冲了过去，最后一步弄湿了尾巴，却一无所获，失去了目标在望的奖品。智者看到火和水不合时宜，就观察事物的本来面目，将其置于其所属的位置，从而使散乱的事物恢复秩序。
像小狐狸尚未到渡河的时机便弄湿了尾巴，你在尚不知前路通向何处、也没有走完全程的把握时就贸然前进。此时硬闯，只会招致羞辱。
你踩住刹车并检查车轮，而不是在尚未准备好的时刻强行穿越；这种纪律，确切地知道何时保持静止，可以让你获得好运。
通道尚未完成，现在出击将会带来毁灭——但现在已经到了集结力量出发渡过大水的时候了，因为价值在于准备渡河，而不是过早强行渡过。
坚持住，悔恨就会消失；凭借突破顽固抵抗的力量，你将漫长的战役进行到底，经过多年的努力，奖励和认可就会到来。
坚定不移，福报无悔，因为贤人的内心光芒，此时正闪耀着真挚的光芒，而真正的光辉，则带来了成功。
渡河成功后，众人分享美酒，喜悦真诚，庆贺本无过错；但若纵饮到酒液浸湿头颈，丢掉所有节制，便会亲手失去原本正当地获得的成果。
完成之前是離彼岸不遠的時刻，火勢已升到水面，兩種力量分崩離析——舊的秩序已經消失，新的秩序還沒有建立，但仍然可以跨越。其中有成功的可能，但只有那些像一隻經驗豐富的狐狸在冰上試探一樣行動的人才能獲得成功。魯莽的小狐狸衝了過去，最後一步弄溼了尾巴，卻一無所獲，失去了目標在望的獎品。智者看到火和水不合時宜，就觀察事物的本來面目，將其置於其所屬的位置，從而使散亂的事物恢復秩序。
像小狐狸尚未到渡河的時機便弄溼了尾巴，你在尚不知前路通向何處、也沒有走完全程的把握時就貿然前進。此時硬闖，只會招致羞辱。
你踩住剎車並檢查車輪，而不是在尚未準備好的時刻強行穿越；這種紀律，確切地知道何時保持靜止，可以讓你獲得好運。
通道尚未完成，現在出擊將會帶來毀滅——但現在已經到了集結力量出發渡過大水的時候了，因為價值在於準備渡河，而不是過早強行渡過。
堅持住，悔恨就會消失；憑藉突破頑固抵抗的力量，你將漫長的戰役進行到底，經過多年的努力，獎勵和認可就會到來。
堅定不移，福報無悔，因為賢人的內心光芒，此時正閃耀著真摯的光芒，而真正的光輝，則帶來了成功。
渡河成功後，眾人分享美酒，喜悅真誠，慶賀本無過錯；但若縱飲到酒液浸溼頭頸，丟掉所有節制，便會親手失去原本正當地獲得的成果。

textFields.text: Before Completion is the moment just short of the far bank, when fire has climbed above water and the two powers pull apart — the old order is gone and the new one has not yet taken hold, but the crossing can still be made. There is success in it, yet only for the one who moves like a seasoned fox testing the ice; the reckless young fox who dashes across and wets its tail at the last step gains nothing, losing the prize with the goal in sight. Seeing fire and water out of place, the wise person examines the true nature of each thing and sets it where it belongs, so that what is scattered can be drawn back toward order.

Like the young fox that soaks its tail trying to cross before its time, you press forward without yet grasping where any of this leads or having the footing to finish — to push ahead now only brings disgrace.
You hold the brake and check the wheels rather than force a crossing the moment is not ready for; this discipline, knowing exactly when to stay still, is what carries you to good fortune.

The passage is not yet complete, and to strike out and attack now would bring ruin — yet the time has come to gather strength and set out across the great water, for the worth lies in readying the crossing, not in forcing it early.
Hold firm and the regret dissolves; with the force to break through entrenched resistance, you carry the long campaign to its end, and after the years of effort the reward and recognition come.
Steadfastness brings good fortune and leaves no regret, for the inner light of the worthy person now shines with true sincerity, and that genuine radiance draws success.

There is honest joy in sharing wine as the crossing is won, and no fault in the celebration — but soak your head in it and abandon all restraint, and you throw away the very thing you had rightfully secured.

textFields.text: 师卦只有在经受过考验、品行端正而能团结众人的领袖率领下，才能成功。缺乏严明纪律与正当理由，人数再多也只会招致败亡；若由合适的人掌握，则有吉运而无过错。卦象是水聚于地中，力量暗藏于地表之下。明智的领袖因而厚待百姓，以慷慨赢得他们的信任，将实力储备到真正需要之时。
军队出发之初就须有清楚的组织和纪律。若一开始便失了秩序，即使目的正当，最终也会遭遇不幸。
统帅置身军中，与士兵同甘共苦，而非高高在上，因此赢得真正的信任。凭着这种稳健中正的作为，来自上位者的嘉奖自然会到来。
若指挥权分裂，或落入无能之人手里，战事就会溃败，车上甚至可能载着阵亡者归来。把行动交给不合适的人，必招灾祸。
审慎撤退并无过错。冒进只会鲁莽时，退到稳固之地是明智的判断，并非失败。
祸患进入田野，理应迎击，但战事必须由经验丰富、肯担责任的领袖指挥。若交给未经历练的人，即使出师有名，最终也会败坏。
胜利之后，君王赐予相称的荣誉、爵位与土地；但不可让小人和无德者长期掌权。要以别的方式酬赏他们，以免他们毁掉已有的成果。
師卦只有在經受過考驗、品行端正而能團結眾人的領袖率領下，才能成功。缺乏嚴明紀律與正當理由，人數再多也只會招致敗亡；若由合適的人掌握，則有吉運而無過錯。卦象是水聚於地中，力量暗藏於地表之下。明智的領袖因而厚待百姓，以慷慨贏得他們的信任，將實力儲備到真正需要之時。
軍隊出發之初就須有清楚的組織和紀律。若一開始便失了秩序，即使目的正當，最終也會遭遇不幸。
統帥置身軍中，與士兵同甘共苦，而非高高在上，因此贏得真正的信任。憑著這種穩健中正的作為，來自上位者的嘉獎自然會到來。
若指揮權分裂，或落入無能之人手裡，戰事就會潰敗，車上甚至可能載著陣亡者歸來。把行動交給不合適的人，必招災禍。
審慎撤退並無過錯。冒進只會魯莽時，退到穩固之地是明智的判斷，並非失敗。
禍患進入田野，理應迎擊，但戰事必須由經驗豐富、肯擔責任的領袖指揮。若交給未經歷練的人，即使出師有名，最終也會敗壞。
勝利之後，君王賜予相稱的榮譽、爵位與土地；但不可讓小人和無德者長期掌權。要以別的方式酬賞他們，以免他們毀掉已有的成果。

textFields.text: The Army succeeds only under a tested, upright leader who can unify a mass of people; without firm discipline and a just cause, sheer numbers lead to ruin, but in the right hands there is good fortune and no fault. Its image is water gathered within the earth — a hidden store beneath the surface — so the wise leader nourishes the people and wins their devotion through generosity, holding strength in reserve until it is truly needed.
An army must march out under clear structure and discipline from the outset; when that ordered footing is missing at the start, even a rightful aim ends in misfortune.
The commander stays among the ranks rather than aloof from them, sharing their lot and so earning real trust; from this steady, centered conduct, honors and reward from above naturally arrive.
When leadership is divided or left to incompetent hands, the campaign collapses and the wagons may carry the dead back home — a venture run by the wrong people invites disaster.
A deliberate withdrawal carries no blame; falling back to firmer ground when advance would be reckless is wise judgment, not defeat.
When trouble enters the field it is right to meet it, but only seasoned, responsible leadership should direct the campaign; hand it to untried people and the effort, however just, ends in ruin.

With victory secured, the ruler grants fitting honors, titles, and lands, but the petty and unworthy must never be placed in lasting positions of power — reward them in other ways, lest they spoil what was won.

textFields.text: 比卦使人得吉，但还要再次审视自己：你是否扎实、持久、稳重，足以让人依靠？若是如此，别人与你相合便无过错，原本犹豫的人也会渐渐靠拢；唯有来得太晚者遭遇不幸。卦象是水在地上，流入每处低洼并与大地紧密相依。古代君王因而安定各地，与治理各地的人维持亲密的关系，凭接近人心而非命令来凝聚众人。
一开始便以质朴的真诚与他人结盟，关系就能稳固而无过错。当信义充满内心，如陶碗盛满至沿，吉运终会从意想不到的方向到来。
让关系从内心生长，根源在自己的诚实，而非刻意追逐。守住自己，以平等的姿态与他人相遇；若从低处卑微求合，只会失去立足之地。坚定守正，便有吉运。
你身边的人并不真正与你同道，他们的路与你的路并行不到一起。保持距离与谨慎；与不合适的人紧紧绑在一起，不会通向值得去的地方。
现在，关系可以正当地显露于外，公开与值得依靠的人相合。坦然表明忠诚并不可耻；坚定追随有能力的人，会带来吉运。
这种联合坦荡而宽厚，犹如君王狩猎时只从三面驱赶猎物，放走从正面逃脱的。愿来者不受逼迫而被接纳，离开者也被放行；人们便自愿靠近，因而吉祥。
这里的联合没有首领，也没有扎根于真正承诺的开端。直到最后、缔结关系的时机已过，才想寻求归属，便失去立足之处，招致不幸。

讓關係從內心生長，根源在自己的誠實，而非刻意追逐。守住自己，以平等的姿態與他人相遇；若從低處卑微求合，只會失去立足之地。堅定守正，便有吉運。
你身邊的人並不真正與你同道，他們的路與你的路並行不到一起。保持距離與謹慎；與不合適的人緊緊綁在一起，不會通向值得去的地方。
現在，關係可以正當地顯露於外，公開與值得依靠的人相合。坦然表明忠誠並不可恥；堅定追隨有能力的人，會帶來吉運。
這種聯合坦蕩而寬厚，猶如君王狩獵時只從三面驅趕獵物，放走從正面逃脫的。願來者不受逼迫而被接納，離開者也被放行；人們便自願靠近，因而吉祥。

textFields.text: Holding together brings good fortune, but consult yourself once more and be sure: are you grounded, lasting, and steady enough to be relied on? If so, others join you without blame, the wavering gradually come around, and only those who arrive too late meet misfortune. The image is water lying upon the earth, seeping into every hollow and clinging fast — so the early kings settled the regions and kept warm bonds with those who governed them, uniting through closeness rather than command.

Bind yourself to others through plain sincerity from the outset, and the tie holds without fault. When that good faith fills you completely, like a clay bowl filled to the brim, good fortune eventually arrives from a quarter you did not expect.

Let the bond grow from within, springing from your own integrity rather than being chased. Hold to who you are and let the connection meet you as an equal; to offer yourself cheaply from below is to lose your standing. Steadfastness brings good fortune.

You find yourself among people who are not truly yours — companions whose path does not run with your own. Keep some distance and stay reserved, for tying yourself to the wrong people leads nowhere worth going.
Now the bond rightly shows itself outwardly, openly joining you to one who is worthy. There is no shame in declaring this loyalty plainly; holding firm in following the capable brings good fortune.

This is union made plain and openhanded, like a king who hunts driving game from three sides only and lets what flees before him go. Those who wish to come are welcomed without pressure, those who turn away are let go, and so people draw near of their own will — good fortune.

Here the union has no head, no beginning rooted in real commitment. To reach for belonging only at the very end, when the moment for forming bonds has already passed, leaves you with nothing to stand on — misfortune.

textFields.text: 小畜卦是一股微小的力量牵制强大的力量，如薄云自西而来，渐渐聚厚，却仍未降雨。此时需要节制与耐心准备，不宜强行推进；先做好近处、力所能及的事，磨炼自身与影响力，宏大的变化仍暂时超出掌控。卦象是风行于广阔天空，无物可握。明智之人便先修饰事物的外在，琢磨品格与仪态，等待时机成熟。
感到前路有阻，便回到自己的道路，不强行推进。返回真正属于自己的位置并非失败，反而使你免于过失，保留前路，继而获得吉运。
见他人已顺势退回，你也与之同行，不独自强进。与合适的人一起退守会带来吉运；选择暂不前进，无须羞愧。
如同车轮上的辐条松脱，合力而行的事猛然停住，再也无法前进。夫妻也互相别过目光，难以和睦；微小的力量越了界，硬要推行只会破坏关系。
形势紧绷、伤害似在眼前时，真诚会消除危险，使恐惧散去。坚守真实，便能安然越过威胁，无伤亦无过。
你的真诚稳稳地联结他人，信任本身成为共同的力量。你们仿佛手牵着手，带动邻人一起富足，而非以他们的损失为代价。
雨终于落下，长久的节制已见成效。耐心的努力与恒常的品格都已成熟，此时可以休息。然而平衡仍然脆弱：月亮将满，若再强推、过分彰显自己，便会招致不幸。

textFields.text: The Taming Power of the Small

A single small force checks a much greater one — like a thin bank of clouds drifting in from the west that thickens but lets down no rain. The time calls for restraint and patient preparation rather than force: you work on what lies near and within reach, refining yourself and your influence while the larger movement stays beyond your grasp. The Image is wind moving across the open sky, with nothing solid to seize, so the wise person tends to the surface of things, polishing character and outward grace until the moment ripens.

Sensing resistance ahead, you turn back to your own path instead of pressing the matter. Returning to where you truly belong is no defeat here — it keeps you free of blame and leaves the way open, and good fortune follows.

Seeing another already drawn back by the moment, you let yourself be pulled back alongside rather than pushing on alone. Retreating in good company carries good fortune; there is no shame in choosing not to advance.

Like a cart whose spokes have sprung loose from the wheels, the joint effort jolts to a halt and can go no further. Husband and wife turn their eyes from each other, unable to keep accord — the small power is overreaching, and forcing things ahead only breaks them.
In a strained moment when harm seems close at hand, sincerity clears the danger away and the dread dissolves. Holding to what is true carries you past the threat without wound and without fault.
Your sincerity binds others to you so steadily that trust itself becomes a shared strength. As though joined hand in hand, you gather your neighbors in and grow richer together, never at their cost.

At last the rain falls and the long restraint has done its work, so for now you may rest, since patient effort and steady character have reached their fullness. But the balance is fragile: the moon stands nearly full, and to press or assert yourself further from here invites misfortune.

zh-CN.text: 半盲的人过信自己的眼睛，跛足的人过信自己的脚步，逞强去做力所不及的事，结果踩中猛虎而被咬。这是弱者假装强大、莽撞冒进，只适合作为受人指挥的雇佣战士。

zh-Hant.text: 半盲的人過信自己的眼睛，跛足的人過信自己的腳步，逞強去做力所不及的事，結果踩中猛虎而被咬。這是弱者假裝強大、莽撞冒進，只適合作為受人指揮的僱傭戰士。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 拔起一根蘆葦，連帶著整束相連的根也拔了出來。有德之人會帶著同類同行；結伴前進，便有吉運。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 连粗朴、未经教养的人也包容进来；不等渡船，勇敢过河；无论距离多远，也不遗忘任何人，更不偏私。守住平衡中正之道，便能回应当下的需要。

zh-Hant.text: 連粗樸、未經教養的人也包容進來；不等渡船，勇敢過河；無論距離多遠，也不遺忘任何人，更不偏私。守住平衡中正之道，便能回應當下的需要。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Take in even the coarse and uncultivated, cross the river boldly without waiting for a boat, forget no one however distant, and play no favorites — hold to the balanced center and you meet what the hour asks of you.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 平地终会转为斜坡，离去之人也终会归来。面对变迁时仍守正直，不为必然到来的变化焦虑，日常的供养便仍有福泽。

zh-Hant.text: 平地終會轉為斜坡，離去之人也終會歸來。面對變遷時仍守正直，不為必然到來的變化焦慮，日常的供養便仍有福澤。

textFields.text: Every level stretch eventually tilts into a slope, every departure circles back to return; stay upright through the turn, do not fret over what is bound to come, and your nourishment will keep its blessing.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 他輕盈而坦蕩地走下來，不倚仗自己的財富，親近身旁的人。居高位者自然地走向低處，出於真誠的信任，而非提防與算計。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 君王讓妹妹下嫁，放下自己的身分，與地位低於自己的人結親。由此獲得真正的福佑與最大的吉運。

zh-Hant.text: 城牆塌回當初取土的壕溝，好的時節已經過去。此時不要興兵，只在自己的城內發佈命令；即使守穩立場，也仍難免有所遺憾。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 拔起一根草，连着一团根也一同带出。有德者退守时并不独行，而是带上同道。艰难之时刚开始，坚定退守会带来吉运，也让前路逐渐明朗。

zh-Hant.text: 拔起一根草，連著一團根也一同帶出。有德者退守時並不獨行，而是帶上同道。艱難之時剛開始，堅定退守會帶來吉運，也讓前路逐漸明朗。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 心胸狭小者靠逢迎顺从度日，这种屈服确实能让他们得利。但坚定守正之人即使默默承受阻碍，也不拿原则换取宠信；正因拒绝，才保全自己的价值。

zh-Hant.text: 心胸狹小者靠逢迎順從度日，這種屈服確實能讓他們得利。但堅定守正之人即使默默承受阻礙，也不拿原則換取寵信；正因拒絕，才保全自己的價值。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: The small-minded survive by fawning and going along, and for them such submission pays. But the steadfast person, though enduring the obstruction quietly, will not trade principle for favor, and by that refusal keeps their worth whole.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 靠不正當手段登位者，心裡藏著羞恥，知道自己的位置並非應得。他們的不安暴露了其地位的虛浮。

textFields.text: Those lifted into place by crooked means carry a swallowed shame; in their own hearts they know the position is undeserved. Their unease betrays how false their standing truly is.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 阻滞即将转机。顺应更高的使命，在时机自然到来而非靠强夺时行动，就能无过地完成工作；所有怀着同样心意做事的人，也会共享随后的益处。

zh-Hant.text: 阻滯即將轉機。順應更高的使命，在時機自然到來而非靠強奪時行動，就能無過地完成工作；所有懷著同樣心意做事的人，也會共享隨後的益處。

textFields.text: Now the obstruction nears its turn. One who acts on a higher mandate, at the moment that is given rather than seized, completes the work without fault, and all who labor in the same spirit come to share the good that follows.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 闭塞开始松动，真正有力量和德行的人得到吉运，但仍不能松懈。他不断提醒自己：『若局面滑脱、事情失败怎么办？』于是牢牢稳住根基，像将物件系在深根的桑树新芽上。

zh-Hant.text: 閉塞開始鬆動，真正有力量和德行的人得到吉運，但仍不能鬆懈。他不斷提醒自己：『若局面滑脫、事情失敗怎麼辦？』於是牢牢穩住根基，像將物件系在深根的桑樹新芽上。

textFields.text: The standstill begins to break, and good fortune comes to the one of real strength and worth — yet this is no time to relax. They keep warning themselves, "What if it slips, what if it fails?" and so bind their footing fast, like a thing lashed to the deep-rooted shoots of a mulberry stump.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 阻礙終於傾覆消失。死寂的停滯轉成寬慰與喜悅；任何局面都不會永遠不變，否塞走到盡頭，便再度轉向流動。

textFields.text: At last the obstruction topples and is gone. What began as dead stagnation breaks open into relief and gladness, for no condition holds forever, and standstill, having run its course, tips over into movement once more.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 在門口、眾人眼前結交。此時沒有隱瞞，也尚未形成派系，公開聯結便無過錯。

textFields.text: Fellowship at the gate, in plain view of all. Because nothing is concealed and no faction has yet taken shape, joining together openly here carries no blame.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 若只与自己的家族结交，便有羞愧。仅与自己一类的人联合，关系狭隘而偏私，达不到此时所需要的坦荡情谊。

zh-Hant.text: 若只與自己的家族結交，便有羞愧。僅與自己一類的人聯合，關係狹隘而偏私，達不到此時所需要的坦蕩情誼。

textFields.text: Fellowship confined to one's own clan brings cause for shame. To bind only with your own kind is a narrow, partial union, and it falls short of the open-handed kinship the moment asks for.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 他把兵器藏在草丛中，爬上高岭守望，防备或许根本不会发生的背叛。三年里他始终戒备，不敢行动，因而期盼的联结迟迟不来。

zh-Hant.text: 他把兵器藏在草叢中，爬上高嶺守望，防備或許根本不會發生的背叛。三年裡他始終戒備，不敢行動，因而期盼的聯結遲遲不來。

textFields.text: He conceals weapons in the brush and climbs the high ridge to keep watch, braced for treachery that may never come. For three years he holds this guarded posture and makes no move, and so the union he longed for never arrives.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 他攀上城墙，似要进攻，却没有真的攻下去。看出此处不能靠武力正当地取胜，他重新回到原则上；这份克制带来吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 他攀上城牆，似要進攻，卻沒有真的攻下去。看出此處不能靠武力正當地取勝，他重新回到原則上；這份剋制帶來吉運。

textFields.text: He scales the rampart as if to attack, but does not carry the assault through. Seeing that force here cannot rightly prevail, he is turned back toward principle, and this restraint brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 原本应该相聚的人起初被隔开，因思念而哭泣呼喊。经过艰苦奋斗，他们终于冲破重重阻碍，在笑声中相逢；坚持渡过挣扎，才能赢得这次相会。

zh-Hant.text: 原本應該相聚的人起初被隔開，因思念而哭泣呼喊。經過艱苦奮鬥，他們終於衝破重重阻礙，在笑聲中相逢；堅持渡過掙扎，才能贏得這次相會。

textFields.text: Those meant to be joined are first held apart, and they weep and cry out in their longing. Yet after great striving they break through every barrier and come together at last in laughter; perseverance through the struggle wins the meeting.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 结交只到城郊为止，联结的是远处的人，而非亲近的伙伴。这虽不至于令人后悔，却仍未实现真正团结最深的心愿。

zh-Hant.text: 結交只到城郊為止，聯結的是遠處的人，而非親近的夥伴。這雖不至於令人後悔，卻仍未實現真正團結最深的心願。

textFields.text: Fellowship reaches only as far as the outskirts, a bond with those at a distance rather than with close companions. There is no regret in it, yet the deepest aim of true union is left unfulfilled.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 起初，你还没有被丰足的有害一面缠住。牢记前方的困难，便能保持无过；这份警惕使财富不致腐蚀你。

zh-Hant.text: 起初，你還沒有被豐足的有害一面纏住。牢記前方的困難，便能保持無過；這份警惕使財富不致腐蝕你。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: At the very start you are not yet entangled with the harmful side of plenty; stay mindful of the difficulty ahead and you remain blameless, for that caution keeps wealth from corrupting you.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 一辆能承载重物的大车已经备妥。有能干的助手与充实的资源，你可以承担真正的责任，向任何方向出发而不受伤害。

zh-Hant.text: 一輛能承載重物的大車已經備妥。有能幹的助手與充實的資源，你可以承擔真正的責任，向任何方向出發而不受傷害。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: A great wagon, built to carry a heavy load, stands ready; with capable helpers and solid resources you can take on real responsibility and set out in any direction without coming to harm.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 贤明的贵族把财物用于侍奉君王、造福众人；心胸狭小者做不到，因为他们只会为自己囤积。

zh-Hant.text: 賢明的貴族把財物用於侍奉君王、造福眾人；心胸狹小者做不到，因為他們只會為自己囤積。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: A worthy noble lays his possessions open in service to the sovereign and the common good; a small-minded person could never do this, for he would only hoard for himself.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 不要炫耀自己的丰足，也不必与身旁最耀眼的人较量。节制财富、不自夸也不挑衅，便能避开嫉妒、免于过失。

zh-Hant.text: 不要炫耀自己的豐足，也不必與身旁最耀眼的人較量。節制財富、不自誇也不挑釁，便能避開嫉妒、免於過失。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Do not flaunt your abundance or measure yourself against those who shine brightest beside you; by holding your wealth in check, unboastful and unprovocative, you escape envy and stay free of fault.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 以真诚敞开的信任待人，同时保有不必刻意展示、却能让人感受到的威严。温厚之中带着沉静的掌控力，使人不把你误认作软弱；你因此赢得拥戴与吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 以真誠敞開的信任待人，同時保有不必刻意展示、卻能讓人感受到的威嚴。溫厚之中帶著沉靜的掌控力，使人不把你誤認作軟弱；你因此贏得擁戴與吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Meet others with sincere, open-hearted trust, yet carry a dignity that is felt rather than displayed; this warmth, kept from being mistaken for weakness by your quiet command, wins devotion and brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 丰足达到顶点时，你蒙受上天的福佑。继续谦逊而正直地行动，不骄傲，便能得到天的眷顾，凡事顺遂。

zh-Hant.text: 豐足達到頂點時，你蒙受上天的福佑。繼續謙遜而正直地行動，不驕傲，便能得到天的眷顧，凡事順遂。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: At the very height of plenty you are blessed from above; by staying humble and right-acting rather than proud, you draw heaven's favor, and nothing fails to go well.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 谦逊之上再加谦逊。不自居高位的人能涉过宽阔的河流，并得吉运；因为不为自己索取，他们才能承担最艰难的路程，安然渡过。

zh-Hant.text: 謙遜之上再加謙遜。不自居高位的人能涉過寬闊的河流，並得吉運；因為不為自己索取，他們才能承擔最艱難的路程，安然渡過。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Modesty layered upon modesty: one who lays no claim to standing can wade across the wide river and meet with fortune, since asking nothing for themselves they can shoulder the hardest passage and come through unharmed.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 谦逊已真切到自然流露，如不敲自鸣的声音。长期坚定守住这份诚实的谦逊，便能获得吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 謙遜已真切到自然流露，如不敲自鳴的聲音。長期堅定守住這份誠實的謙遜，便能獲得吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Humility grown so real that it rings out of its own accord, like a tone heard without being struck; to keep faith with such honest modesty steadily over time draws good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 确实做出了功绩，却仍保持平和谦逊；即使成就很多，也不自高的人，能把任务完整做到底，并获得吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 確實做出了功績，卻仍保持平和謙遜；即使成就很多，也不自高的人，能把任務完整做到底，並獲得吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Genuine work and earned merit joined to a quiet manner: because such a one stays unassuming even after achieving much, the task is brought fully to its close and fortune follows.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 无论往哪个方向行动，都适宜以谦逊为引导。此时应把谦逊明白地付诸行动，以服务来带领众人，而不越过自己的位置。

zh-Hant.text: 無論往哪個方向行動，都適宜以謙遜為引導。此時應把謙遜明白地付諸行動，以服務來帶領眾人，而不越過自己的位置。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: In every direction it serves to let modesty guide one's movement; here it is right to act and to put humility plainly into practice, leading through service without ever pushing past one's place.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 不必靠财富也能得到邻人的帮助。立足于谦逊，此时宜坚定行动；必要时可用强硬手段纠正局面，事情不会出错。

zh-Hant.text: 不必靠財富也能得到鄰人的幫助。立足於謙遜，此時宜堅定行動；必要時可用強硬手段糾正局面，事情不會出錯。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Wealth is not needed to win a neighbor's help; from this modest standing it is fitting to move with firmness, to set things right by force where that is called for, and nothing will go amiss.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 长期在内心回响的谦逊，如今落实于行动。可以派兵，但只应整顿自己的城邑和土地，绝不可伸手夺取界外之物。

zh-Hant.text: 長期在內心迴響的謙遜，如今落實於行動。可以派兵，但只應整頓自己的城邑和土地，絕不可伸手奪取界外之物。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Modesty that has long sounded inwardly now carries over into deeds; it is right to send the troops forward, yet only to bring order to one's own city and land, never to reach for what lies outside them.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 四处宣扬自己的好运和与权贵的亲近，只把力量耗在炫耀上。这样张扬的热情很快燃尽，终将招致不幸。

zh-Hant.text: 四處宣揚自己的好運和與權貴的親近，只把力量耗在炫耀上。這樣張揚的熱情很快燃盡，終將招致不幸。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Broadcasting your good fortune and your closeness to those in power spends the energy on display alone; enthusiasm paraded this way burns out quickly and ends in misfortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 如磐石般稳固，你在一日未尽时已察觉转机，既不抢先，也不滞留太久。准确把握何时前行、何时止步，才是真正的明辨；坚持于此，便有吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 如磐石般穩固，你在一日未盡時已察覺轉機，既不搶先，也不滯留太久。準確把握何時前行、何時止步，才是真正的明辨；堅持於此，便有吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Steady as bedrock, you sense the turn before a single day has passed and neither rush ahead nor cling on too long; this exact feel for when to move and when to halt is true discernment, and holding to it brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 仰望上位者、犹豫地等待他们示意，会带来悔恨。若不凭自己的判断行动，只等别人许可，时机便会过去，徒留懊悔。

zh-Hant.text: 仰望上位者、猶豫地等待他們示意，會帶來悔恨。若不憑自己的判斷行動，只等別人許可，時機便會過去，徒留懊悔。

textFields.text: Gazing upward at those above and hesitating for their cue invites regret; wait too long for permission instead of acting on your own reading, and the moment passes, leaving only remorse.

zh-CN.text: 你所遵循的事物正在发生变化，如果你坚持正确的事情，这种变化就是合理的。不要把自己封闭起来——走出你熟悉的圈子，在开阔的地方结识新朋友，这些新鲜的联系将会结出硕果。

zh-Hant.text: 你所遵循的事物正在發生變化，如果你堅持正確的事情，這種變化就是合理的。不要把自己封閉起來——走出你熟悉的圈子，在開闊的地方結識新朋友，這些新鮮的聯繫將會結出碩果。

textFields.text: What you follow is shifting, and that change is sound if you hold to what is right. Don't seal yourself off — step beyond your familiar circle and meet people on open ground, and these fresh connections will bear fruit.

zh-CN.text: 执着于微小的、亲密的依恋，你就会放弃强大而有价值的依恋。你不能同时持有两者，所以要仔细权衡你要绑定哪一个。

zh-Hant.text: 執著於微小的、親密的依戀，你就會放棄強大而有價值的依戀。你不能同時持有兩者，所以要仔細權衡你要綁定哪一個。

zh-CN.text: 守住有力量且值得追随的人，放下次要的牵挂，追随的心愿便能实现。在这条更高的路上保持坚定、端正，对你有益。

zh-Hant.text: 守住有力量且值得追隨的人，放下次要的牽掛，追隨的心願便能實現。在這條更高的路上保持堅定、端正，對你有益。

zh-CN.text: 这里的忠诚已经牢固到紧密相系。如此坚定的追随会得到最高的礼遇，仿佛君王在圣山上以祭礼敬待忠诚之人。

zh-Hant.text: 這裡的忠誠已經牢固到緊密相系。如此堅定的追隨會得到最高的禮遇，彷彿君王在聖山上以祭禮敬待忠誠之人。

textFields.text: Here allegiance has grown so firm it binds completely, loyalty held fast and tied tight. Such devotion is honored at the highest level — as a king presents the faithful one with offerings on the sacred mountain.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 你正在修复你父亲毁掉的一切。因为有一个有能力的继承人挺身而出去修补它，所以留下它的父亲就不会受到任何责备；道虽有险，终有福。

zh-Hant.text: 你正在修復你父親毀掉的一切。因為有一個有能力的繼承人挺身而出去修補它，所以留下它的父親就不會受到任何責備；道雖有險，終有福。

textFields.text: You are repairing what your father let go to ruin. Because a capable heir steps up to mend it, no blame clings to the father who left it behind; the way passes through danger, yet it ends in good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你在纠正母亲留下的弊病，那是一种较柔弱、细微的失序。不要强硬地逼迫改变；过分严厉只会造成伤害，无法治愈，应以柔和的方式着手。

zh-Hant.text: 你在糾正母親留下的弊病，那是一種較柔弱、細微的失序。不要強硬地逼迫改變；過分嚴厲只會造成傷害，無法治癒，應以柔和的方式著手。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You are setting right what your mother spoiled — a softer, more tender disorder. Do not press the correction with rigid insistence; too much severity would wound rather than heal, so proceed with a yielding hand.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 在弥补父亲的过失方面，你做得有些过分，引起了一些悔恨。尽管如此，积极的修复，即使是用力地进行修复，也不会带来严重的错误——过度的热情比让腐烂继续存在要好得多。

zh-Hant.text: 在彌補父親的過失方面，你做得有些過分，引起了一些悔恨。儘管如此，積極的修復，即使是用力地進行修復，也不會帶來嚴重的錯誤——過度的熱情比讓腐爛繼續存在要好得多。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: In mending the father's failings you go somewhat too far and stir a little remorse. Still, energetic repair, even when a touch heavy-handed, brings no serious fault — far better an excess of zeal than to let the decay stand.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你与你父亲留下的废墟和平相处，并推迟了修复它的工作。如果继续沉溺其中，等待你的只有耻辱，因为缺乏任何补救措施，腐败会加深。

zh-Hant.text: 你與你父親留下的廢墟和平相處，並推遲了修復它的工作。如果繼續沉溺其中，等待你的只有恥辱，因為缺乏任何補救措施，腐敗會加深。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You make peace with the ruin your father left and put off the work of fixing it. Carry on indulging it and only disgrace awaits you, as the spoilage deepens for lack of any move to mend it.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你接手父亲尚未完成的修整，把事情重新理顺，因而得到赞誉。无须独自劳作；合适的助手会聚来，与你一起完成复原。

zh-Hant.text: 你接手父親尚未完成的修整，把事情重新理順，因而得到讚譽。無須獨自勞作；合適的助手會聚來，與你一起完成復原。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You take up the father's unfinished repair and carry it through to order, and you are met with praise. You need not labor alone; the right helpers gather to you and the restoration is completed together.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你不再侍奉国王和王子，摆脱了世界上错综复杂的修复工作。你坚持更崇高、更自由的目标，设定自己的标准，并回应超越普通服务的价值。

zh-Hant.text: 你不再侍奉國王和王子，擺脫了世界上錯綜複雜的修復工作。你堅持更崇高、更自由的目標，設定自己的標準，並回應超越普通服務的價值。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You no longer serve kings and princes, stepping clear of the world's tangled work of repair. You hold to loftier, freer aims, setting your own measure and answering to a worth that lies beyond ordinary service.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你会与志同道合的人齐心协力，只要你们都坚持正确的事情，这种共同的进步就会带来好运。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你与他人齐心协力，道路畅通而幸运；不要因为最终衰落的警告而感到不安，因为时间本身正在引领你前进。

zh-Hant.text: 你與他人齊心協力，道路暢通而幸運；不要因為最終衰落的警告而感到不安，因為時間本身正在引領你前進。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

zh-CN.text: 这是智慧之道，适合执政者：选择有能力的人，把工作委托给他们，让他们为你做事，而不是事事亲力亲为，这会带来好运。

zh-Hant.text: 這是智慧之道，適合執政者：選擇有能力的人，把工作委託給他們，讓他們為你做事，而不是事事親力親為，這會帶來好運。

textFields.text: This is the approach of wisdom, fitting for one who governs: you choose able people, entrust the work to them, and let them act for you rather than gripping everything yourself, and this brings good fortune.

zh-CN.text: 这是全心而慷慨的接近，带来吉运且没有过错。年长而品格高尚的人俯身帮助仍在学习的人，这份开放的心意只会带来好结果。

zh-Hant.text: 你以行動裝點雙腳，下車步行。捨棄會損害原則的借來安逸，選擇樸實、誠實地走自己的路，才是更真實的修飾。

zh-Hant.text: 裂縫一直延伸到床架。毀滅越來越近，而同伴和保護者卻逐漸遠去，因此一個人被孤立，暴露在外，沒有堅實的立足點可以依靠。

zh-Hant.text: 腐爛已經結束，一顆巨大的果實未受影響地懸掛著，孕育著接下來的種子。賢者如乘馬車而前行，而拆毀者則毀壞了自己的屋頂。

zh-Hant.text: 你只走了一小段路就發現自己並返回，所以沒有任何東西被破壞；趁著小差錯及時糾正，會帶來大好運。

zh-Hant.text: 你懷著一顆寬厚而誠實的心回來，坦率地評判自己，沒有任何藉口；如此大度的自我修正，沒有什麼可遺憾的。

zh-Hant.text: 坑很深，真正的危險包圍著你，所以不要去尋求任何大型救援。只瞄準那些小事和力所能及的事情，一步步獲得適度的收穫，直到最壞的時刻過去。

textFields.text: The pit is deep and real danger surrounds you, so do not reach for any grand rescue. Aim only for what is small and within grasp, securing modest gains step by step until the worst is behind you.

zh-CN.text: 夹在一个深渊和另一个深渊之间，前进或后退的每个方向都会陷入更深的水中。因为任何举动只会让你进一步沉沦，所以不要挣扎或采取行动；停下来，保持不动，不要让自己陷入其中。

zh-Hant.text: 夾在一個深淵和另一個深淵之間，前進或後退的每個方向都會陷入更深的水中。因為任何舉動只會讓你進一步沉淪，所以不要掙扎或採取行動；停下來，保持不動，不要讓自己陷入其中。

textFields.text: Caught between one abyss and the next, every direction forward or back drops into deeper water. Since any move only sinks you further, do not struggle or act; pause, hold still, and refuse to throw yourself in.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 深陷险境时，暂且放下一切礼节：一壶酒、一碗饭，以朴素的陶器从窗中诚实递过，便已足够。艰难之时，人与人之间返璞归真的真诚，最终不会招致过错。

zh-Hant.text: 深陷險境時，暫且放下一切禮節：一壺酒、一碗飯，以樸素的陶器從窗中誠實遞過，便已足夠。艱難之時，人與人之間返璞歸真的真誠，最終不會招致過錯。

textFields.text: In the depth of the danger, set all ceremony aside: a single jug of wine, a bowl of rice, plain earthen vessels passed honestly through the window are enough. Stripped-down sincerity between people in hard times brings no blame in the end.

zh-Hant.text: 水還沒有溢出峽谷，只是剛剛漲到邊緣，就會在那裡沉澱下來。不要過度；只填充到危險趨於平穩的程度，你就可以順利度過難關。

zh-Hant.text: 你被繩索捆綁，被關在荊棘籬笆後面，完全迷失在深淵裡，三年都找不到出路。如果你繼續犯這樣的錯誤，你就會被困很長很長的時間，這就是不幸。

zh-CN.text: 你在门槛前停滞，尚未迈步便遇到阻碍。与其强行冲撞，不如耐心守住位置、扎下根基。此时要把合适的人聚到身边，以服务者而非主人的姿态相待，才能渡过难关。

zh-Hant.text: 你在門檻前停滯，尚未邁步便遇到阻礙。與其強行衝撞，不如耐心守住位置、紮下根基。此時要把合適的人聚到身邊，以服務者而非主人的姿態相待，才能渡過難關。

textFields.text: You stall at the threshold, checked before you can move; rather than push against the block, hold your ground with patience and put down roots. Drawing the right people to your side now, and meeting them as a servant rather than a master, is what carries you through.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 障碍接连出现，进展停顿，仿佛马与车分离，再也走不动。前来接近你的人并非劫掠者，而是等待时机的真诚求婚者；意志坚定的人不会仓促许诺，直到时节转变，十年之后，结合才能恰当地成立。应等待真实可信之事，而非只图眼前可得。

zh-Hant.text: 障礙接連出現，進展停頓，彷彿馬與車分離，再也走不動。前來接近你的人並非劫掠者，而是等待時機的真誠求婚者；意志堅定的人不會倉促許諾，直到時節轉變，十年之後，結合才能恰當地成立。應等待真實可信之事，而非只圖眼前可得。

textFields.text: Obstacles stack up and progress halts, as if horse and cart pulled apart and could go no further. One who approaches you is no raider but an honest suitor awaiting the right moment; the steady-hearted does not pledge herself in haste, and only when the season turns—ten years on—does the bond rightly form. Wait for what is true, not what is merely at hand.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 没有熟悉山林的人引路，却追着鹿闯入树林，只会在林间迷失。懂得审时度势的人看出此处无猎物可得，便及时折返；盲目追赶，只会招致悔恨。

zh-Hant.text: 沒有熟悉山林的人引路，卻追著鹿闖入樹林，只會在林間迷失。懂得審時度勢的人看出此處無獵物可得，便及時折返；盲目追趕，只會招致悔恨。

textFields.text: To chase the deer into the forest with no forester to guide you is only to lose yourself among the trees. One who reads the moment well sees there is no quarry to be had and turns back in time; to press blindly onward leads straight into regret.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 馬與車再次分離，但此處的出路在於主動尋求聯結：走向能夠與你合作、助你一臂之力的人。懷著這樣的心意前進會有吉運，付出的努力也不會白費。

textFields.text: Again horse and cart stand apart, but here the answer is to reach out: move toward the one who can join with you and lend their strength. Going forward in this spirit brings good fortune, and nothing is wasted in the effort.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你给予和影响他人的力量被阻住，尚无法到达需要它的人，就像水渠还没有开通。眼下适度、目标明确的行动仍能带来真正的益处；若在通道未开时强求大规模施展，只会落得毁坏。先滋养今天能够滋养的，其余留待来日。

zh-Hant.text: 你給予和影響他人的力量被阻住，尚無法到達需要它的人，就像水渠還沒有開通。眼下適度、目標明確的行動仍能帶來真正的益處；若在通道未開時強求大規模施展，只會落得毀壞。先滋養今天能夠滋養的，其餘留待來日。

textFields.text: Your means to give and to influence are dammed up, unable to reach those who need them—the channels are not yet dug. Modest, well-aimed action still does real good, but forcing a grand release now, before the way is open, only ends in ruin. Nourish what can be nourished today and let the rest wait.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 挣扎到了尽头，一切都停滞了；马与车彻底分离，悲伤化作血泪流下。能尝试的路都已试过，却没有一条走得通。真正的解脱是停止强求，容许自己感受失去并痛哭，而非继续争斗。

zh-Hant.text: 掙扎到了盡頭，一切都停滯了；馬與車徹底分離，悲傷化作血淚流下。能嘗試的路都已試過，卻沒有一條走得通。真正的解脫是停止強求，容許自己感受失去並痛哭，而非繼續爭鬥。

zh-CN.text: 你处于撤退的尾部，排在最后，并面临着不断逼近的危险。这是一个危险的地方，所以不要尝试，也不要采取行动；保持安静和静止是你度过难关的秘诀。

zh-Hant.text: 你處於撤退的尾部，排在最後，並面臨著不斷逼近的危險。這是一個危險的地方，所以不要嘗試，也不要採取行動；保持安靜和靜止是你度過難關的秘訣。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 一次又一次被阻礙和阻礙的撤退是緊張的、令人不安的、危險的。依附於你的眷屬是原因，所以對待他們就像對待你自己的家人一樣——這樣照顧他們就會使情況變得好運。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

textFields.text: To step back of your own free will brings good fortune to the one who can do it cleanly, finding release rather than loss. The small-minded person clings and cannot let go, and that refusal is their undoing.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 这是一次良好的撤退——亲切、适时、没有苦涩——得到内心坚定的支持，知道撤退的确切时机。因为选择是正确的、是清醒的，所以坚持下去就会带来好运。

zh-Hant.text: 這是一次良好的撤退——親切、適時、沒有苦澀——得到內心堅定的支持，知道撤退的確切時機。因為選擇是正確的、是清醒的，所以堅持下去就會帶來好運。

textFields.text: This is a retreat on good terms — gracious, well-timed, free of bitterness — backed by the inner firmness to know the exact moment to withdraw. Because the choice is right and clear-eyed, persistence in it brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 这是轻松而无忧的退守：自由离开，没有牵累，也没有迟疑。所有束缚都已解开，前路宽阔，整个局势因而转为有利。

zh-Hant.text: 這是輕鬆而無憂的退守：自由離開，沒有牽累，也沒有遲疑。所有束縛都已解開，前路寬闊，整個局勢因而轉為有利。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: This is a light-hearted, untroubled retreat, made freely with nothing clinging to you and no doubt to slow your step. With every tie released and the road wide open, the whole situation turns to your advantage.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 力量聚集在脚趾处——全是向前的冲动，下面没有任何地面。从这个最低点继续前进会带来不幸，因为没有立足点的原始驱动力无法达到目标。

zh-Hant.text: 力量聚集在腳趾處——全是向前的衝動，下面沒有任何地面。從這個最低點繼續前進會帶來不幸，因為沒有立足點的原始驅動力無法達到目標。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Power gathered in the toes — all forward urge and no ground beneath it. To press ahead from this lowest place brings misfortune, since raw drive without a footing cannot reach its aim.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 保持稳定会带来好运。在这里，真正的力量不会遇到任何阻力，并且会以正确的方式前进，顺势而行，而不是勉强过去。

zh-Hant.text: 保持穩定會帶來好運。在這裡，真正的力量不會遇到任何阻力，並且會以正確的方式前進，順勢而行，而不是勉強過去。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: To hold steady brings good fortune. Here genuine strength meets no resistance and advances in right measure, moving with the moment instead of straining past it.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 心胸狭隘的人，把自己的力量表现出来；智者拿着它，就好像它毫无重量一样。像公羊用头撞栅栏一样冲向每一个障碍物只会让牛角陷入困境，让你被牢牢地困住。

zh-Hant.text: 心胸狹隘的人，把自己的力量表現出來；智者拿著它，就好像它毫無重量一樣。像公羊用頭撞柵欄一樣衝向每一個障礙物只會讓牛角陷入困境，讓你被牢牢地困住。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: The small-minded spend their strength on display; the wise carry it as if it weighed nothing. To charge each obstacle like a ram driving its head at a fence only snares the horns and leaves you stuck fast.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 坚定的坚持会带你渡过难关，悔恨也会消失：栅栏不费吹灰之力就分开了。现在的力量就像一辆大车的车轴，承受全部负载并滚动——力量通过稳定而不是碰撞来表达。

zh-Hant.text: 堅定的堅持會帶你渡過難關，悔恨也會消失：柵欄不費吹灰之力就分開了。現在的力量就像一輛大車的車軸，承受全部負載並滾動——力量通過穩定而不是碰撞來表達。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Steady persistence carries you through and regret melts away: the fence parts without a fight. The strength now works like the axle of a great cart, bearing the whole load and rolling on — power voiced through steadiness rather than collision.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 轻松地释放顽固的碰撞驱动力，就像在旷野中让山羊从你手中滑落一样。没有什么可遗憾的，因为如此轻易掌握的力量不再需要守护或强迫。

zh-Hant.text: 輕鬆地釋放頑固的碰撞驅動力，就像在曠野中讓山羊從你手中滑落一樣。沒有什麼可遺憾的，因為如此輕易掌握的力量不再需要守護或強迫。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Release the stubborn, butting drive as lightly as letting a goat slip from your hands in open country. There is nothing to regret, for strength held this easily no longer needs guarding or forcing.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 公羊撞进树篱，犄角卡住，既不能退，也不能进。起初无路可行；看清困境、暂时止步，最后才会使局势转向吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 公羊撞進樹籬，犄角卡住，既不能退，也不能進。起初無路可行；看清困境、暫時止步，最後才會使局勢轉向吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: The ram has driven into the hedge and can move neither back nor on, its horns held fast. At first no path will serve; yet to see the bind clearly and stay still is what at last turns the way toward good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你向前迈进，却被拒绝或不信任；保持坚定和正直，不要因为失去信心而生气，即使奖励被扣留，也要保持冷静的慷慨——诚实地迎接延误，不会责怪你。

zh-Hant.text: 你向前邁進，卻被拒絕或不信任；保持堅定和正直，不要因為失去信心而生氣，即使獎勵被扣留，也要保持冷靜的慷慨——誠實地迎接延誤，不會責怪你。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You move to advance and are turned back or distrusted; stay firm and upright, take no offense at the missing confidence, and hold a calm generosity even when reward is withheld — meet the delay honestly and no blame falls on you.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 此时的晋升笼罩着忧伤与不安，但只要守正，吉运仍会到来。福佑来自祖辈，来自一位女性先人；你坚定不移时，支持会以间接的方式抵达。

zh-Hant.text: 此時的晉升籠罩著憂傷與不安，但只要守正，吉運仍會到來。福佑來自祖輩，來自一位女性先人；你堅定不移時，支持會以間接的方式抵達。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Advancing now is shadowed by sorrow and unease, but keep to what is correct and good fortune will come; the blessing reaches you from an ancestral source, a maternal forebear above — support arrives indirectly when you remain steadfast.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你周围的每个人都信任你并分享你的目标，所以先前的犹豫消失了，所有的遗憾都消失了；怀着共同的信心，你们毫无疑虑地共同前进。

zh-Hant.text: 你周圍的每個人都信任你並分享你的目標，所以先前的猶豫消失了，所有的遺憾都消失了；懷著共同的信心，你們毫無疑慮地共同前進。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Everyone around you places their trust in you and shares your aim, so the earlier hesitation falls away and all cause for regret dissolves; carried by common confidence, you advance together without misgiving.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 像穴居啮齿动物一样，推进贪婪和胆怯、囤积，是一种偷偷摸摸的、不稳定的做法；无论你对自己的想象多么正确，坚持这种方式进步会让你处于真正的危险之中。

zh-Hant.text: 像穴居齧齒動物一樣，推進貪婪和膽怯、囤積，是一種偷偷摸摸的、不穩定的做法；無論你對自己的想像多麼正確，堅持這種方式進步會讓你處於真正的危險之中。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: To push ahead grasping and timid, hoarding like a burrowing rodent, is a furtive and unstable course; however correct you imagine yourself, clinging to advancement this way keeps you in real danger.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 安于真正进步之处，抛开一切得失忧虑；无论你做什么都会有好的结果，而对结果的忧虑只会让已经对你有利的好运蒙上阴影。

zh-Hant.text: 安於真正進步之處，拋開一切得失憂慮；無論你做什麼都會有好的結果，而對結果的憂慮只會讓已經對你有利的好運蒙上陰影。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Settled in the place of true progress, set aside all anxiety over gain and loss; whatever you undertake turns out well, and fretting over the outcome only clouds the good fortune already moving in your favor.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 低下头角、强势冲击，只适合用来纠正自家或本城的过失。用于此处，可由险转吉；若拿来征服他人，仍然危险。即使用力有其道理，也难免蒙受些许羞辱。

zh-Hant.text: 低下頭角、強勢衝擊，只適合用來糾正自家或本城的過失。用於此處，可由險轉吉；若拿來征服他人，仍然危險。即使用力有其道理，也難免蒙受些許羞辱。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Pressing forward with horns lowered to strike is fit only for correcting faults within your own household or city; turned there it succeeds and the danger passes into good fortune, but used to subdue others it stays perilous, and even justified force here ends in some humiliation.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 一开始，光翅膀被击打而飞翔，及时感知到伤害并撤回，三天不吃东西，而不是在有毒的桌子上进食；你所经过的人都反对你撤退，但在自己的路上挨饿，远比徘徊在毁灭中要好。

zh-Hant.text: 一開始，光翅膀被擊打而飛翔，及時感知到傷害並撤回，三天不吃東西，而不是在有毒的桌子上進食；你所經過的人都反對你撤退，但在自己的路上捱餓，遠比徘徊在毀滅中要好。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: At the outset the light takes flight with its wings beaten down, sensing harm in time and pulling back, going three days without food rather than feeding at a poisoned table; the people you pass speak against your retreat, but going hungry on your own road is far better than lingering to be ruined.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你的左大腿受了伤，行动变慢且疼痛，却还没有被击垮，仍可移动。此时应立即行动，借强壮坐骑的力量护送他人脱险，尽力相助，而非只顾照料自己的伤口。

zh-Hant.text: 你的左大腿受了傷，行動變慢且疼痛，卻還沒有被擊垮，仍可移動。此時應立即行動，借強壯坐騎的力量護送他人脫險，盡力相助，而非只顧照料自己的傷口。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You are wounded in the left thigh — slowed and hurt, yet not broken, still able to move; the right response is to act at once and carry others to safety with the power of a sturdy mount, lending your strength rather than nursing the injury.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 当你在南方狩猎时，你将黑暗之流的领导者逼入绝境，这是一个真正让世界恢复正常的机会；即便如此，也不要要求一刀切，因为伤根深了，急不得。

zh-Hant.text: 當你在南方狩獵時，你將黑暗之流的領導者逼入絕境，這是一個真正讓世界恢復正常的機會；即便如此，也不要要求一刀切，因為傷根深了，急不得。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: While hunting in the south you corner the very leader from whom the darkness flows, a true opening to put the world right; even so, do not demand that everything be mended in a single stroke, for damage with deep roots will not yield to haste.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你进入房子阴暗面的内室，抓住真正驱使当权者的因素；一旦你读懂了它的核心内容，你就会向大门走去，并在门关上之前离开。

zh-Hant.text: 你進入房子陰暗面的內室，抓住真正驅使當權者的因素；一旦你讀懂了它的核心內容，你就會向大門走去，並在門關上之前離開。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: You pass into the inner chambers on the dark side of the house and lay hold of what truly drives those in power; once you have read the rot at its core, you make for the gate and take your leave before the door closes on you.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 就像暴君的亲戚为了比他更长久而戴着疯狂的面具一样，你必须遮住你的光芒，同时坚守正义；事实证明，即使隐藏着内心的真相，安静的忍耐也能守护它，这才是值得的。

textFields.text: Regret fades on its own — let the horse that bolted go rather than chase it, for it finds its own way back; and when a disagreeable person crosses your path, meet them rather than shun them, since driving them off by force only breeds real hostility, though you stay watchful against missteps.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 你在狹窄的巷子裡偶然遇見了你的主人，在狹窄的環境中意外的相遇——這並沒有錯，因為無論什麼小路打開，重新聯繫正是疏遠所需要的。

textFields.text: You meet your lord by chance in a narrow lane, an unplanned encounter in cramped circumstances — there is no fault in this, for reconnecting by whatever side path opens is exactly what estrangement calls for.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你感觉你的车被向后拖着，你的牛被拖着，你被当众羞辱，就好像你的头发和鼻子被割掉了一样——这是一种羞辱性的、受阻的开始；然而这里并没有真正的开始，它将会有一个好的结局，因为障碍不会持续。

zh-Hant.text: 你感覺你的車被向後拖著，你的牛被拖著，你被當眾羞辱，就好像你的頭髮和鼻子被割掉了一樣——這是一種羞辱性的、受阻的開始；然而這裡並沒有真正的開始，它將會有一個好的結局，因為障礙不會持續。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 在你周围的反对之中，你孤立无援，最终遇到了一个你可以信任的志趣相投的人；尽管情况很危险，但诚实地与那个盟友联合起来可以消除错误并使你稳定下来。

zh-Hant.text: 在你周圍的反對之中，你孤立無援，最終遇到了一個你可以信任的志趣相投的人；儘管情況很危險，但誠實地與那個盟友聯合起來可以消除錯誤並使你穩定下來。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Cut off and alone amid the opposition around you, you at last meet a kindred spirit you can trust; though the situation is dangerous, joining honestly with that one ally clears the fault and steadies you.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 遗憾消失了：你真正的伴侣像撕破柔软的皮肤一样轻易地咬穿了将你分开的东西，来到了你身边——前进并与他们联合起来，这样的相遇有什么可指责的呢？

zh-Hant.text: 遺憾消失了：你真正的伴侶像撕破柔軟的皮膚一樣輕易地咬穿了將你分開的東西，來到了你身邊——前進並與他們聯合起來，這樣的相遇有什麼可指責的呢？

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Regret vanishes: your true companion bites clean through what wraps you apart, as easily as through soft skin, and comes to you — go forward and unite with them, for what blame could lie in such a meeting?

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 孤立到了极处，你把同伴看成满身污泥的猪、载满鬼怪的车，还举弓欲射。随后你放下弓，看清来者并非强盗，而是前来结亲的亲人；猜疑消散，雨落下来，局势转吉。

zh-Hant.text: 孤立到了極處，你把同伴看成滿身汙泥的豬、載滿鬼怪的車，還舉弓欲射。隨後你放下弓，看清來者並非強盜，而是前來結親的親人；猜疑消散，雨落下來，局勢轉吉。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 继续前进，你就会直接陷入更糟糕的麻烦；相反，等待，原地踏步的耐心将为你赢得安静的信誉。

zh-Hant.text: 繼續前進，你就會直接陷入更糟糕的麻煩；相反，等待，原地踏步的耐心將為你贏得安靜的信譽。

zh-Hant.text: 對於忠誠服務的人來說，障礙重重，但這些障礙都不是源於他們的任何過錯；他們受責任的約束，繼續前進，追求比個人利益更大的目標。

textFields.text: Obstacle stacks on obstacle for the one in loyal service, yet none of it springs from any fault of theirs; they press on, bound by duty to something larger than personal gain.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 前进的道路只会把困难引向更深，所以你又回到了曾经值得信赖的伙伴身边；这种回归坚定的立场是稳定，而不是投降。

zh-Hant.text: 前進的道路只會把困難引向更深，所以你又回到了曾經值得信賴的夥伴身邊；這種迴歸堅定的立場是穩定，而不是投降。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 独自前进只会遇到更多的障碍，所以你会回来与你的上位者会合；如此巨大的僵局可以通过联盟来解决，将自己与一个更强大的合作伙伴结合起来，而不是单打独斗。

zh-Hant.text: 獨自前進只會遇到更多的障礙，所以你會回來與你的上位者會合；如此巨大的僵局可以通過聯盟來解決，將自己與一個更強大的合作伙伴結合起來，而不是單打獨鬥。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 在最困難的障礙的核心，盟友們趕來分擔重擔；當你面臨最大的壓力時，你所保持的穩定性和平衡會吸引朋友到你身邊。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 要破除蒙昧，起初需要一定的纪律，坚定的纠正有助于松动坏习惯。但界限一旦确立，束缚便应解除；若把严厉惩罚当成全部教法，而非通往理解的起点，只会使受教者蒙羞、变得顽固，最终留下悔恨。

zh-Hant.text: 要破除矇昧，起初需要一定的紀律，堅定的糾正有助於鬆動壞習慣。但界限一旦確立，束縛便應解除；若把嚴厲懲罰當成全部教法，而非通往理解的起點，只會使受教者蒙羞、變得頑固，最終留下悔恨。

textFields.text: To break through ignorance, some discipline is needed at the outset, and a firm correction can be useful for loosening bad habits. But once it has served to set a limit, the constraint must be lifted; if rigid punishment becomes the whole method instead of a door into understanding, it only shames and hardens the one being taught, and the effort ends in regret.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 此处的力量在于耐心：以平和之心包容无知与尚未成熟的人，不要求他们立刻变得明智。这份宽容甚至能接纳一位粗朴的伴侣进入家庭，赢得其信任；善意承担这些责任的人，也能维系好整个家庭。

zh-Hant.text: 此處的力量在於耐心：以平和之心包容無知與尚未成熟的人，不要求他們立刻變得明智。這份寬容甚至能接納一位粗樸的伴侶進入家庭，贏得其信任；善意承擔這些責任的人，也能維繫好整個家庭。

textFields.text: The strength here is patience: carry the foolish and the immature with an even temper, rather than demanding they already be wise. Such tolerance can even welcome a rough or unpolished partner into the household and win their trust, and the one who bears these burdens kindly holds the family together well.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 不要只因对方有权势或光彩夺目，就急着投向他，在讨好中失去立足点与自尊。这样轻易交出自己，得不到好结果；守住自己，不要追逐一切耀眼之物。

zh-Hant.text: 不要只因對方有權勢或光彩奪目，就急著投向他，在討好中失去立足點與自尊。這樣輕易交出自己，得不到好結果；守住自己，不要追逐一切耀眼之物。

textFields.text: Do not fling yourself at someone merely because they are powerful or dazzling, losing your footing and self-respect in the rush to please them. A person who gives themselves away like this gains nothing good, so keep hold of yourself instead of chasing whatever glitters.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 这是陷在蒙昧中的人：沉迷与现实隔绝的幻想，又拒绝能够使自己清醒的纠正。这样的固执会一直缠绕于空想，直到终于面对现实，羞愧才会止息。

zh-Hant.text: 這是陷在矇昧中的人：沉迷與現實隔絕的幻想，又拒絕能夠使自己清醒的糾正。這樣的固執會一直纏繞於空想，直到終於面對現實，羞愧才會止息。

textFields.text: This is folly that gets stuck — spinning fantasies sealed off from anything real and refusing the correction that could free it. Such stubbornness stays tangled in empty imaginings, and shame is the outcome until reality is finally faced.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 这是天真而愿意学习的蒙昧，如同没有自负的孩子，以开放的心接受教导。这份谦逊的意愿会带来吉运；不设防、肯受教的心容易吸收指引，并逐渐成长。

zh-Hant.text: 這是天真而願意學習的矇昧，如同沒有自負的孩子，以開放的心接受教導。這份謙遜的意願會帶來吉運；不設防、肯受教的心容易吸收指引，並逐漸成長。

textFields.text: This is the folly of the innocent who learns with an open mind, like a child without conceit, glad to be taught. That humble willingness draws good fortune, because the unguarded and teachable mind takes in instruction easily and grows.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 必须以强硬手段应对蒙昧时，目的在于制止伤害，而非泄愤或为惩罚而惩罚。要坚定地阻止错误行为，不要残酷地对待犯错的人；让纠正成为保护，而非新的伤害。赶走侵扰者，别让自己也变成侵扰者。

zh-Hant.text: 必須以強硬手段應對矇昧時，目的在於制止傷害，而非洩憤或為懲罰而懲罰。要堅定地阻止錯誤行為，不要殘酷地對待犯錯的人；讓糾正成為保護，而非新的傷害。趕走侵擾者，別讓自己也變成侵擾者。

textFields.text: When folly must be met with force, the purpose is to stop the harm, not to vent anger or punish for its own sake. usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 一开始，当压力消失时，没有什么可做的，也没有什么可负责的。保持安静，少说话，让缓解自行缓解。

zh-Hant.text: 一開始，當壓力消失時，沒有什麼可做的，也沒有什麼可負責的。保持安靜，少說話，讓緩解自行緩解。

textFields.text: At the very beginning, just as the strain lets go, there is nothing yet to do and nothing to answer for. Stay still, say little, and let the relief settle on its own.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 就像猎人在田野里捕获三只狐狸并获得一支黄柄箭一样，你要清除那些对你不利的狡猾、隐藏的东西，并保持笔直、平衡的路线。坚持下去，财富就会随之而来。

zh-Hant.text: 就像獵人在田野裡捕獲三隻狐狸並獲得一支黃柄箭一樣，你要清除那些對你不利的狡猾、隱藏的東西，並保持筆直、平衡的路線。堅持下去，財富就會隨之而來。

textFields.text: As a hunter takes three foxes in the field and is given a yellow-shafted arrow, you clear out the sly, hidden things working against you and hold to a straight, balanced course. Stay true to it and fortune follows.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 背负重物，却又乘坐一辆精美的马车，就等于夺取了你不曾赢得的地位——这会引诱小偷向你靠近。炫耀你无法支持的东西会招致损失，无论你感觉如何正确，最终都会带来耻辱。

zh-Hant.text: 揹負重物，卻又乘坐一輛精美的馬車，就等於奪取了你不曾贏得的地位——這會引誘小偷向你靠近。炫耀你無法支持的東西會招致損失，無論你感覺如何正確，最終都會帶來恥辱。

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 让自己摆脱错误的陪伴，释放那些束缚你的小束缚，就像紧紧抓住你自己的脚趾一样。一旦他们离开，真正属于你的人就会到来，那个人是可以信任的。

zh-Hant.text: 讓自己擺脫錯誤的陪伴，釋放那些束縛你的小束縛，就像緊緊抓住你自己的腳趾一樣。一旦他們離開，真正屬於你的人就會到來，那個人是可以信任的。

textFields.text: Free yourself of the wrong company, releasing the small, clinging ties that hold you back like a grip on your own toe. Once they are gone, the one who truly belongs with you arrives, and that person can be trusted.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 真正有德之人能摆脱缠绕自己的事物，局势便会好转。与之分离本身就是证明：小人会自行离开，你的真诚也使这场决裂在众人面前清楚可见。

zh-Hant.text: 真正有德之人能擺脫纏繞自己的事物，局勢便會好轉。與之分離本身就是證明：小人會自行離開，你的真誠也使這場決裂在眾人面前清楚可見。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: When a person of real worth can cut themselves loose from what entangles them, things go well. The proof is in the parting itself: the petty fall away of their own accord, and your sincerity makes the break plain to all.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 就像一位王子瞄准高墙上栖息的鹰并将其击倒一样，你以干净利落、果断的一枪消除了最后一个顽固的障碍。当时机成熟并且你付诸实践时，一切都会朝着对你有利的方向发展。

zh-Hant.text: 就像一位王子瞄準高牆上棲息的鷹並將其擊倒一樣，你以乾淨利落、果斷的一槍消除了最後一個頑固的障礙。當時機成熟並且你付諸實踐時，一切都會朝著對你有利的方向發展。

textFields.text: Like a prince taking aim at a hawk perched on a high wall and bringing it down, you remove the last stubborn obstacle with one clean, decisive shot. When the moment is ripe and you strike true, everything moves in your favor.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 坚守自己的立场。现在不是推进某些冒险的时候，因为强迫事情会出错。通过保持自己完整而不是为了取悦而耗尽精力，你就能丰富他人。

zh-Hant.text: 堅守自己的立場。現在不是推進某些冒險的時候，因為強迫事情會出錯。通過保持自己完整而不是為了取悅而耗盡精力，你就能豐富他人。

textFields.text: Hold steady to your own ground. This is not the hour to push forward into some venture, for forcing the matter goes wrong; by keeping yourself intact rather than draining away to please, you are able to enrich others.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 三人同行，摩擦逐渐消耗彼此，其中一人终会离开；独行的人却很快会遇到与自己相配的那位同伴。真正的结伴，要等人群缩成真诚的一对才能形成。

zh-Hant.text: 減少自己的失敗，不拖泥帶水地去做，你所希望的人就會高興地來迎接你；減輕你的負擔，你所需要的就會快樂地到來，沒有任何責備。

zh-Hant.text: 命運降臨，一切都無法扭轉——就像十對龜殼豐富了一樣，其答案無人能反駁。當命運如此眷顧你時，不要拒絕；只需接收即可。

textFields.text: Fortune arrives that nothing can turn aside — as though enriched by ten pairs of tortoise shells whose answer no one can gainsay. When destiny favors you this completely, do not refuse it; simply receive.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 现在你可以为别人带来好处，而自己却一无所失，在你周围增加一切，而不剥夺下面的任何东西。你的善行会作为对每个人的祝福而向外传播，你会聚集广泛的追随者，不再局限于某个家庭。

zh-Hant.text: 現在你可以為別人帶來好處，而自己卻一無所失，在你周圍增加一切，而不剝奪下面的任何東西。你的善行會作為對每個人的祝福而向外傳播，你會聚集廣泛的追隨者，不再侷限於某個家庭。

zh-CN.text: 当你诚实地面对损失和困难事件时，即使是损失和困难事件也能让你变得丰富。坚持诚恳的中庸之道，坦白地陈述自己的情况，像拿着公章一样为自己提供诚信的证据。

zh-Hant.text: 當你誠實地面對損失和困難事件時，即使是損失和困難事件也能讓你變得豐富。堅持誠懇的中庸之道，坦白地陳述自己的情況，像拿著公章一樣為自己提供誠信的證據。

zh-Hant.text: 保持平衡的中心，你的判斷就會受到信任。作為忠實的中間人，當權者將追隨你的領導——即使在像將整個社區遷移到新的領域這樣重大的事情上也足以支持你。

textFields.text: Hold the balanced center, and your judgment will be trusted. Serve as a faithful go-between, and those in power will follow your lead—enough to back you even in a matter as weighty as moving an entire community to new ground.

zh-CN.text: 当你的心是真诚的、不求回报的时候，你就不用问事情是否顺利。最高的祝福来临了，因为别人看到了你的善良，并以自己的善意回报你。

zh-Hant.text: 當你的心是真誠的、不求回報的時候，你就不用問事情是否順利。最高的祝福來臨了，因為別人看到了你的善良，並以自己的善意回報你。

zh-Hant.text: 你感覺腳趾向前壓很有力量，急於前進，但你出發時卻未能滿足任務的要求；在你能夠完成任務之前就行動起來，這會讓你的努力變成一次失誤。

zh-CN.text: 在刚开始时就停止柔和的、侵入性的影响，就像在推车滚动之前用金属支架锁住车轮一样；克制则福，放任则害。它就像一头瘦小猪，踱步、烦躁——现在很小，但不安分，如果没有人阻止它，它就不愿意保持小状态。

zh-Hant.text: 底部的水是清澈的，但只夠到魚，罐子破裂了，水就流走了。當真正的能力被花在瑣事上或年久失修時，它就被浪費了，永遠不會上升到可以被它滋養的人。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 井正在用石頭重新襯砌，恢復良好。退後一步來修復並穩定自己，即使這會打斷你對他人的付出，也是明智的工作，不會有任何過錯。

textFields.text: The well is being relined with stone, set back in good order. Stepping back to repair and steady yourself, even when it interrupts what you give to others, is sound work and carries no fault.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 大鍋裡裝的是真正的物質，所以你攜帶的是真正有價值的東西；競爭對手可能會討厭你的充實，但如果你保持鎮定，他們就無法聯繫到你來破壞它。小心翼翼地堅持下去，好運就會隨之而來。

zh-CN.text: 第一次震动会让你尖叫、颤抖，但当它过去时，你又会笑起来，又轻松自在；事实证明，恐惧是一种祝福，因为警报让你保持警觉并保持镇定。幸运。

zh-Hant.text: 第一次震動會讓你尖叫、顫抖，但當它過去時，你又會笑起來，又輕鬆自在；事實證明，恐懼是一種祝福，因為警報讓你保持警覺並保持鎮定。幸運。

zh-CN.text: 震惊伴随着真正的危险而来，你的贵重物品大量被卷走；不要追赶他们，而是撤到高处让他们走。失去的东西会在七日之内自动找回来。

zh-Hant.text: 震驚伴隨著真正的危險而來，你的貴重物品大量被捲走；不要追趕他們，而是撤到高處讓他們走。失去的東西會在七日之內自動找回來。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-Hant.text: 震驚讓你驚慌失措、不知所措、困惑不已。但如果這種令人不安的情緒促使你採取行動並把事情糾正過來，那麼你就能順利度過它。

zh-CN.text: 在这里，震动让你陷入困境，你陷入泥沼；被松软的地面包围，无法找到牵引力，你无法干净利落地前进，直到重新站稳脚跟。

zh-Hant.text: 在這裡，震動讓你陷入困境，你陷入泥沼；被鬆軟的地面包圍，無法找到牽引力，你無法乾淨利落地前進，直到重新站穩腳跟。

zh-CN.text: 震动来来回回，来来去去，危险从未减弱；然而，如果你坚持自己的中心，就不会失去任何真正有价值的东西，而且还有真正的工作等待你去完成。

zh-Hant.text: 震動來來回回，來來去去，危險從未減弱；然而，如果你堅持自己的中心，就不會失去任何真正有價值的東西，而且還有真正的工作等待你去完成。

textFields.text: The shock strikes back and forth, coming and going, and the danger never lets up; yet if you hold to your center, nothing of true worth is lost, and there remains real work for you to carry out.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 震惊让你无所适从，恐惧地四处张望，现在继续前进会带来不幸。但是，当它仍然落在你的邻居身上而不是你身上时，请尽早发出警告并靠边站；尽管亲戚可能会抱怨你的谨慎，但你自己却不会受到责备。

zh-Hant.text: 震驚讓你無所適從，恐懼地四處張望，現在繼續前進會帶來不幸。但是，當它仍然落在你的鄰居身上而不是你身上時，請儘早發出警告並靠邊站；儘管親戚可能會抱怨你的謹慎，但你自己卻不會受到責備。

textFields.text: The shock leaves you undone, staring about in dread, and to press ahead now would bring misfortune. But while it still falls on your neighbor and not yet on you, take warning early and step aside; though kin may mutter and fault your caution, you yourself stay free of blame.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 脚趾保持静止——在迈出第一步之前就停下来，而回来的路还很短，而且没有任何问题。保持这种早期的克制，并让它保持下去。

zh-Hant.text: 腳趾保持靜止——在邁出第一步之前就停下來，而回來的路還很短，而且沒有任何問題。保持這種早期的剋制，並讓它保持下去。

textFields.text: Stillness in the toes — halt before the first step is taken, while the path back is still short and nothing has gone wrong. Stay constant in this early restraint, and let it hold.

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 寂静到达小腿，但前面的人继续前行，不会停下来。无法拯救你所追随的人，你就被牵着走，心里郁闷不安。

zh-Hant.text: 寂靜到達小腿，但前面的人繼續前行，不會停下來。無法拯救你所追隨的人，你就被牽著走，心裡鬱悶不安。

records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 停在腰间，使腰胯僵硬得仿佛要裂开。这是强行压制出来的静止，并非自然到来的安定。过度的克制压住呼吸，使内心因窒息般的恐惧而暗自灼烧。

zh-Hant.text: 停在腰間，使腰胯僵硬得彷彿要裂開。這是強行壓制出來的靜止，並非自然到來的安定。過度的剋制壓住呼吸，使內心因窒息般的恐懼而暗自灼燒。

textFields.text: Halting at the waist locks the loins until they feel ready to split apart — a stillness imposed by force, not one allowed to arrive. Restraint pressed this hard smothers the breath and leaves the heart smoldering with suffocated dread.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-CN.text: 静止进入躯干——自我的躯干开始静止，而不仅仅是运动的部分。这是安静地到达核心；喧闹的自我平静下来，一切都顺利。

zh-Hant.text: 靜止進入軀幹——自我的軀幹開始靜止，而不僅僅是運動的部分。這是安靜地到達核心；喧鬧的自我平靜下來，一切都順利。

zh-CN.text: 在向前推进和向后撤退之间摇摆会让你变得分散和虚弱。补救办法是纪律严明的士兵的坚定：选择一个方向，坚持下去，用坚定的决心来解决动摇。

zh-Hant.text: 在向前推進和向後撤退之間搖擺會讓你變得分散和虛弱。補救辦法是紀律嚴明的士兵的堅定：選擇一個方向，堅持下去，用堅定的決心來解決動搖。

zh-CN.text: 隐藏的破坏性力量正在悄然兴起，就像隐藏在床底下的东西一样。通过耐心、彻底的搜索，自由地向每一位勤奋的帮助者和顾问求助，将他们吸引到公开的地方；揭露埋藏的东西会给你带来好运并消除你的责备。

zh-Hant.text: 隱藏的破壞性力量正在悄然興起，就像隱藏在床底下的東西一樣。通過耐心、徹底的搜索，自由地向每一位勤奮的幫助者和顧問求助，將他們吸引到公開的地方；揭露埋藏的東西會給你帶來好運並消除你的責備。

zh-Hant.text: 遺憾消失了，努力的成果顯而易見：就像一次成功的狩獵，需要三種獵物，足以與周圍的人分享。謙遜加上果斷的行動會帶來充分的、應得的回報。

zh-Hant.text: 滲透到了極致，它本身就會失敗，就像在床底下搜尋得很深，沒有任何東西可以站立一樣。你已經放棄了你的資源和你所使用的工具；從這裡繼續前進只會導致不幸。

zh-CN.text: 在浅薄的快乐与更高的善之间摇摆，迟迟不作决定，便无法安宁。一旦舍弃廉价的享乐，转向真正稳妥的道路，不安便会变为真实的喜悦。

textFields.text: Torn between a shallow delight and a higher good, you find no peace while the choice hangs unmade; once you turn from the cheap pleasure toward what is sound, the unrest gives way to true gladness.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

zh-Hant.text: 把你的信任寄託在那些悄悄地讓你疲憊不堪的事情上，會帶來真正的危險。看到它的腐蝕性影響是什麼，而不是讓它的魅力解除你的武裝。

zh-Hant.text: 僅僅為了引誘和吸引他人而存在的快樂已經失去了所有內在的方向，現在被慾望而不是任何有價值的目標所統治。

zh-Hant.text: 在疏遠才剛剛開始並且仍然很容易扭轉的時候提供幫助。立即採取行動，以一匹好馬的準備力量，在任何寒冷來臨之前，心會再次軟化。

zh-Hant.text: 當事情開始變得鬆散時，迅速移動到任何能讓你穩定的地方，並依靠它作為立足點。這樣做，因疏遠而產生的遺憾就會消失。

textFields.text: As things begin to come loose, move quickly to whatever steadies you and lean on it for footing. Do this, and the regret that grows out of estrangement falls away.

zh-CN.text: 现在你融化了你自己的自我专注，把你的私人需求放在一边。把自己奉献给更大的事业，你就不会因为孤立而孤独而感到遗憾。

zh-Hant.text: 現在你融化了你自己的自我專注，把你的私人需求放在一邊。把自己奉獻給更大的事業，你就不會因為孤立而孤獨而感到遺憾。

textFields.text: Now you melt away your own self-absorption and set your private wants aside. Losing yourself in service to something larger, you are spared the regret of standing apart and alone.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你打破了自己的派系，放弃了自己所属的狭隘圈子——结果非常好。从这种分散中，一种更广泛、更真实的团契形成了，这是普通人无法提前想象的。

zh-Hant.text: 你打破了自己的派系，放棄了自己所屬的狹隘圈子——結果非常好。從這種分散中，一種更廣泛、更真實的團契形成了，這是普通人無法提前想像的。

textFields.text: You break up your own faction and let go of the narrow circle you belonged to — and this turns out wonderfully well. From that scattering a wider, truer fellowship takes shape, one no ordinary outlook could have pictured in advance.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 危机达到顶点时，领导者应发出强有力的团结号召，使它像汗液流遍全身那样传遍众人；以清楚而能凝聚人心的话语，使分散的力量围绕值得信赖的中心重新汇聚。这样做的领袖能够安稳无过。

zh-Hant.text: 危機達到頂點時，領導者應發出強有力的團結號召，使它像汗液流遍全身那樣傳遍眾人；以清楚而能凝聚人心的話語，使分散的力量圍繞值得信賴的中心重新匯聚。這樣做的領袖能夠安穩無過。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: At the peak of the crisis, let a great unifying call move through the people the way sweat moves through the body — one clear, rallying word — so the scattering energy collects around a worthy center. The leader who does this stays secure and free of fault.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 带领自己和身边的人远离前方的伤害，便能消散危险本身。让伤口流尽淤血，远离威胁，除去伤害的源头，就不会招致过错。

zh-Hant.text: 帶領自己和身邊的人遠離前方的傷害，便能消散危險本身。讓傷口流盡淤血，遠離威脅，除去傷害的源頭，就不會招致過錯。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Dissolve the danger itself by leading yourself and your own clear of the harm ahead. Let the wound bleed itself out, keep well away from what threatens, and by removing the source of injury you stay free of blame.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 让争执及时止息，不要久拖。或许会有些闲话，但只要不把摩擦扩大，事情终能妥善收场。

zh-Hant.text: 讓爭執及時止息，不要久拖。或許會有些閒話，但只要不把摩擦擴大，事情終能妥善收場。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Let the matter drop instead of dragging it on. A little gossip may follow, but keeping the friction small means it ends well.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 对手过于强大，难以战胜，不要硬争；退回家中，停止争斗。你拒绝交战，便使整座三百户的城邑免于被卷入伤害。

zh-Hant.text: 對手過於強大，難以戰勝，不要硬爭；退回家中，停止爭鬥。你拒絕交戰，便使整座三百戶的城邑免於被捲入傷害。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
