textFields.text: You face an opponent too strong to beat, so do not push the quarrel; pull back to your own home and stand down. By refusing the fight you spare your whole town of three hundred households from being dragged into harm.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 凭已经挣得的价值安身，知道局势危险，仍坚定守住自己的位置，最终会有好结果。若为更有地位的人效力，要把工作做完，不争夺功劳。

zh-Hant.text: 憑已經掙得的價值安身，知道局勢危險，仍堅定守住自己的位置，最終會有好結果。若為更有地位的人效力，要把工作做完，不爭奪功勞。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Live on the worth you have already earned and hold steady, knowing the ground is dangerous; in the end it turns out well. If you serve someone greater, finish the work without grasping at the credit for yourself.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你有力量硬把争端推下去，却不会成功。转身回来，接受眼前的局面，让心意转向正确的方向；安于此道，便有吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 你有力量硬把爭端推下去，卻不會成功。轉身回來，接受眼前的局面，讓心意轉向正確的方向；安於此道，便有吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: You have the strength to force the dispute, but it cannot succeed. Turn back, accept how things stand, and let your heart change toward what is right; settling into that brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 将争端交给真正公正的裁断者。在这里，你会遇到诚实的仲裁，得到所能得到的最好结果。

zh-Hant.text: 將爭端交給真正公正的裁斷者。在這裡，你會遇到誠實的仲裁，得到所能得到的最好結果。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Bring your case before one who judges with true fairness. Here the conflict meets an honest arbiter, and the outcome is the best it can be.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 即使争斗使你登上高位，得到象征官阶的佩饰，这种争来的奖赏也不能使人安宁；一早还未过去，它就会一次又一次地被夺去、被人争执。

zh-Hant.text: 即使爭鬥使你登上高位，得到象徵官階的佩飾，這種爭來的獎賞也不能使人安寧；一早還未過去，它就會一次又一次地被奪去、被人爭執。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Suppose strife carries you to the top and you are handed a badge of rank. A prize won by fighting gives no peace; before the morning is out it will be torn from you and contested, again and again.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 当庭院和门都关闭并且禁止移动时，请在自己的门槛内保持静止；知道不走出去，本身就是正当的界限，也无可厚非。

zh-Hant.text: 當庭院和門都關閉並且禁止移動時，請在自己的門檻內保持靜止；知道不走出去，本身就是正當的界限，也無可厚非。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: When the courtyard and its gate are closed and the moment forbids movement, hold still within your own threshold; knowing not to step out is itself the right limit, and it draws no blame.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 现在内门敞开，出去的时间明显到了，你却在自己的房间里耽搁；当需要采取行动时就克制自己，这是不合时宜的，而且会带来不幸。

zh-Hant.text: 現在內門敞開，出去的時間明顯到了，你卻在自己的房間裡耽擱；當需要採取行動時就剋制自己，這是不合時宜的，而且會帶來不幸。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Now the inner gate stands open and the time to go forth has plainly come, yet you delay within your rooms; to restrain yourself when action is called for is mistimed, and it brings misfortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 不接受任何尺度而超越界限​​的人，留下的是叹息和遗憾；然而，既然过度是自愿选择的，那么过错就在自己身上，没有任何责任在外。

zh-Hant.text: 不接受任何尺度而超越界限​​的人，留下的是嘆息和遺憾；然而，既然過度是自願選擇的，那麼過錯就在自己身上，沒有任何責任在外。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: One who will accept no measure and overflows every bound is left with sighing and regret; yet since the excess was freely chosen, the fault lies nowhere but with oneself, and no blame falls outside.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 顺应处境所容许的范围，安然接受限制而不强求，行动便少有阻力，得以成功。节制若顺着事物的自然形势，就无须付出额外代价。

zh-Hant.text: 順應處境所容許的範圍，安然接受限制而不強求，行動便少有阻力，得以成功。節制若順著事物的自然形勢，就無須付出額外代價。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Limitation that settles into place with ease, resting content within what circumstance allows rather than forcing it, moves without friction and meets success; restraint costs nothing when it follows the natural shape of things.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 心甘情愿地接受自己的限制，并在要求别人之前先忍受它，让它变得甜蜜，这会带来好运。以身作则，勇往直前，赢得荣誉和奖励。

zh-Hant.text: 心甘情願地接受自己的限制，並在要求別人之前先忍受它，讓它變得甜蜜，這會帶來好運。以身作則，勇往直前，贏得榮譽和獎勵。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: To take the limit upon yourself willingly, and to make it sweet by bearing it before requiring it of others, brings good fortune; act first by your own example, and going forward wins honor and reward.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 克制到令人恼火、痛苦的极端是无法维持的，坚持下去会招致毁灭和悔恨。但如果一个季节确实需要如此严格，那么接受它的艰辛就可以让遗憾消失。

zh-Hant.text: 剋制到令人惱火、痛苦的極端是無法維持的，堅持下去會招致毀滅和悔恨。但如果一個季節確實需要如此嚴格，那麼接受它的艱辛就可以讓遺憾消失。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Restraint driven to a galling, bitter extreme cannot hold, and to cling to it invites ruin and regret; but where such severity is truly required for a season, accepting its hardship lets the regret pass away.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 安定于自身，准备充分而心无旁骛，便有吉祥；但当你又暗暗把信任寄托在别的可能性上时，那份内心的安宁就会消失。

zh-Hant.text: 安定於自身，準備充分而心無旁騖，便有吉祥；但當你又暗暗把信任寄託在別的可能性上時，那份內心的安寧就會消失。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Standing settled in yourself, ready and undivided, brings good fortune; but the moment you quietly pin your trust on some other prospect as well, that inner calm slips away.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 一只鸟儿从阴影中呼唤，而它那看不见的幼鸟会做出回应：真实的感觉可以跨越任何距离。你身上真实的东西会在另一个人身上引起回响，就像一杯酒变成了令人愉快地分享的东西一样。

zh-Hant.text: 一隻鳥兒從陰影中呼喚，而它那看不見的幼鳥會做出回應：真實的感覺可以跨越任何距離。你身上真實的東西會在另一個人身上引起迴響，就像一杯酒變成了令人愉快地分享的東西一樣。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: A bird calls from the shadows and its young, unseen, answers back: real feeling carries across any distance on its own. What is true in you summons its echo in another, the way an offered cup of wine becomes something gladly shared.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 当你把自己绑在一个掌控一切的伙伴身上后，你在敲鼓和沉默之间、在眼泪和歌声之间摇摆不定。完全从别人那里借来的快乐会让你被他们的每一种情绪所困扰。

zh-Hant.text: 當你把自己綁在一個掌控一切的夥伴身上後，你在敲鼓和沉默之間、在眼淚和歌聲之間搖擺不定。完全從別人那裡借來的快樂會讓你被他們的每一種情緒所困擾。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: Having tied yourself to a partner who holds all the strings, you lurch between beating the drum and falling silent, between tears and song. Joy taken wholly on loan from someone else leaves you tossed by their every mood.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 如将满未满的月亮，你离开往日的同伴，转向更高之处；套在车辕上的马脱离马队，循自己的道路前行，仍忠于本心，因此没有过错。

zh-Hant.text: 如將滿未滿的月亮，你離開往日的同伴，轉向更高之處；套在車轅上的馬脫離馬隊，循自己的道路前行，仍忠於本心，因此沒有過錯。

zh-CN.text: 渡河成功后，众人分享美酒，喜悦真诚，庆贺本无过错；但若纵饮到酒液浸湿头颈，丢掉所有节制，便会亲手失去原本正当地获得的成果。

zh-Hant.text: 渡河成功後，眾人分享美酒，喜悅真誠，慶賀本無過錯；但若縱飲到酒液浸溼頭頸，丟掉所有節制，便會親手失去原本正當地獲得的成果。

textFields.text: There is honest joy in sharing wine as the crossing is won, and no fault in the celebration — but soak your head in it and abandon all restraint, and you throw away the very thing you had rightfully secured.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 军队出发之初就须有清楚的组织和纪律。若一开始便失了秩序，即使目的正当，最终也会遭遇不幸。

zh-Hant.text: 軍隊出發之初就須有清楚的組織和紀律。若一開始便失了秩序，即使目的正當，最終也會遭遇不幸。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: An army must march out under clear structure and discipline from the outset; when that ordered footing is missing at the start, even a rightful aim ends in misfortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 统帅置身军中，与士兵同甘共苦，而非高高在上，因此赢得真正的信任。凭着这种稳健中正的作为，来自上位者的嘉奖自然会到来。

zh-Hant.text: 統帥置身軍中，與士兵同甘共苦，而非高高在上，因此贏得真正的信任。憑著這種穩健中正的作為，來自上位者的嘉獎自然會到來。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: The commander stays among the ranks rather than aloof from them, sharing their lot and so earning real trust; from this steady, centered conduct, honors and reward from above naturally arrive.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 若指挥权分裂，或落入无能之人手里，战事就会溃败，车上甚至可能载着阵亡者归来。把行动交给不合适的人，必招灾祸。

zh-Hant.text: 若指揮權分裂，或落入無能之人手裡，戰事就會潰敗，車上甚至可能載著陣亡者歸來。把行動交給不合適的人，必招災禍。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: When leadership is divided or left to incompetent hands, the campaign collapses and the wagons may carry the dead back home — a venture run by the wrong people invites disaster.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 审慎撤退并无过错。冒进只会鲁莽时，退到稳固之地是明智的判断，并非失败。

zh-Hant.text: 審慎撤退並無過錯。冒進只會魯莽時，退到穩固之地是明智的判斷，並非失敗。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: A deliberate withdrawal carries no blame; falling back to firmer ground when advance would be reckless is wise judgment, not defeat.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 祸患进入田野，理应迎击，但战事必须由经验丰富、肯担责任的领袖指挥。若交给未经历练的人，即使出师有名，最终也会败坏。

zh-Hant.text: 禍患進入田野，理應迎擊，但戰事必須由經驗豐富、肯擔責任的領袖指揮。若交給未經歷練的人，即使出師有名，最終也會敗壞。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: When trouble enters the field it is right to meet it, but only seasoned, responsible leadership should direct the campaign; hand it to untried people and the effort, however just, ends in ruin.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 胜利之后，君王赐予相称的荣誉、爵位与土地；但不可让小人和无德者长期掌权。要以别的方式酬赏他们，以免他们毁掉已有的成果。

zh-Hant.text: 勝利之後，君王賜予相稱的榮譽、爵位與土地；但不可讓小人和無德者長期掌權。要以別的方式酬賞他們，以免他們毀掉已有的成果。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。

textFields.text: With victory secured, the ruler grants fitting honors, titles, and lands, but the petty and unworthy must never be placed in lasting positions of power — reward them in other ways, lest they spoil what was won.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 一开始便以质朴的真诚与他人结盟，关系就能稳固而无过错。当信义充满内心，如陶碗盛满至沿，吉运终会从意想不到的方向到来。

zh-Hant.text: 一開始便以質樸的真誠與他人結盟，關係就能穩固而無過錯。當信義充滿內心，如陶碗盛滿至沿，吉運終會從意想不到的方向到來。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Bind yourself to others through plain sincerity from the outset, and the tie holds without fault. When that good faith fills you completely, like a clay bowl filled to the brim, good fortune eventually arrives from a quarter you did not expect.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 让关系从内心生长，根源在自己的诚实，而非刻意追逐。守住自己，以平等的姿态与他人相遇；若从低处卑微求合，只会失去立足之地。坚定守正，便有吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 讓關係從內心生長，根源在自己的誠實，而非刻意追逐。守住自己，以平等的姿態與他人相遇；若從低處卑微求合，只會失去立足之地。堅定守正，便有吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Let the bond grow from within, springing from your own integrity rather than being chased. Hold to who you are and let the connection meet you as an equal; to offer yourself cheaply from below is to lose your standing. Steadfastness brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你身边的人并不真正与你同道，他们的路与你的路并行不到一起。保持距离与谨慎；与不合适的人紧紧绑在一起，不会通向值得去的地方。

zh-Hant.text: 你身邊的人並不真正與你同道，他們的路與你的路並行不到一起。保持距離與謹慎；與不合適的人緊緊綁在一起，不會通向值得去的地方。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: You find yourself among people who are not truly yours — companions whose path does not run with your own. Keep some distance and stay reserved, for tying yourself to the wrong people leads nowhere worth going.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 现在，关系可以正当地显露于外，公开与值得依靠的人相合。坦然表明忠诚并不可耻；坚定追随有能力的人，会带来吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 現在，關係可以正當地顯露於外，公開與值得依靠的人相合。坦然表明忠誠並不可恥；堅定追隨有能力的人，會帶來吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Now the bond rightly shows itself outwardly, openly joining you to one who is worthy. There is no shame in declaring this loyalty plainly; holding firm in following the capable brings good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 这种联合坦荡而宽厚，犹如君王狩猎时只从三面驱赶猎物，放走从正面逃脱的。愿来者不受逼迫而被接纳，离开者也被放行；人们便自愿靠近，因而吉祥。

zh-Hant.text: 這種聯合坦蕩而寬厚，猶如君王狩獵時只從三面驅趕獵物，放走從正面逃脫的。願來者不受逼迫而被接納，離開者也被放行；人們便自願靠近，因而吉祥。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: This is union made plain and openhanded, like a king who hunts driving game from three sides only and lets what flees before him go. Those who wish to come are welcomed without pressure, those who turn away are let go, and so people draw near of their own will — good fortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 这里的联合没有首领，也没有扎根于真正承诺的开端。直到最后、缔结关系的时机已过，才想寻求归属，便失去立足之处，招致不幸。

zh-Hant.text: 這裡的聯合沒有首領，也沒有紮根於真正承諾的開端。直到最後、締結關係的時機已過，才想尋求歸屬，便失去立足之處，招致不幸。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Here the union has no head, no beginning rooted in real commitment. To reach for belonging only at the very end, when the moment for forming bonds has already passed, leaves you with nothing to stand on — misfortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 感到前路有阻，便回到自己的道路，不强行推进。返回真正属于自己的位置并非失败，反而使你免于过失，保留前路，继而获得吉运。

zh-Hant.text: 感到前路有阻，便回到自己的道路，不強行推進。返回真正屬於自己的位置並非失敗，反而使你免於過失，保留前路，繼而獲得吉運。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Sensing resistance ahead, you turn back to your own path instead of pressing the matter. Returning to where you truly belong is no defeat here — it keeps you free of blame and leaves the way open, and good fortune follows.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 见他人已顺势退回，你也与之同行，不独自强进。与合适的人一起退守会带来吉运；选择暂不前进，无须羞愧。

zh-Hant.text: 見他人已順勢退回，你也與之同行，不獨自強進。與合適的人一起退守會帶來吉運；選擇暫不前進，無須羞愧。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Seeing another already drawn back by the moment, you let yourself be pulled back alongside rather than pushing on alone. Retreating in good company carries good fortune; there is no shame in choosing not to advance.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 如同车轮上的辐条松脱，合力而行的事猛然停住，再也无法前进。夫妻也互相别过目光，难以和睦；微小的力量越了界，硬要推行只会破坏关系。

zh-Hant.text: 如同車輪上的輻條鬆脫，合力而行的事猛然停住，再也無法前進。夫妻也互相別過目光，難以和睦；微小的力量越了界，硬要推行只會破壞關係。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Like a cart whose spokes have sprung loose from the wheels, the joint effort jolts to a halt and can go no further. Husband and wife turn their eyes from each other, unable to keep accord — the small power is overreaching, and forcing things ahead only breaks them.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 形势紧绷、伤害似在眼前时，真诚会消除危险，使恐惧散去。坚守真实，便能安然越过威胁，无伤亦无过。

zh-Hant.text: 形勢緊繃、傷害似在眼前時，真誠會消除危險，使恐懼散去。堅守真實，便能安然越過威脅，無傷亦無過。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: In a strained moment when harm seems close at hand, sincerity clears the danger away and the dread dissolves. Holding to what is true carries you past the threat without wound and without fault.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 你的真诚稳稳地联结他人，信任本身成为共同的力量。你们仿佛手牵着手，带动邻人一起富足，而非以他们的损失为代价。

zh-Hant.text: 你的真誠穩穩地聯結他人，信任本身成為共同的力量。你們彷彿手牽著手，帶動鄰人一起富足，而非以他們的損失為代價。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: Your sincerity binds others to you so steadily that trust itself becomes a shared strength. As though joined hand in hand, you gather your neighbors in and grow richer together, never at their cost.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens
records.usageEvidence: Family-level reader/call-site trace; conditional field visibility is documented in runtime-flow.md.

zh-CN.text: 雨终于落下，长久的节制已见成效。耐心的努力与恒常的品格都已成熟，此时可以休息。然而平衡仍然脆弱：月亮将满，若再强推、过分彰显自己，便会招致不幸。

zh-Hant.text: 雨終於落下，長久的節制已見成效。耐心的努力與恆常的品格都已成熟，此時可以休息。然而平衡仍然脆弱：月亮將滿，若再強推、過分彰顯自己，便會招致不幸。

records.notes: 父级 hexagram 条目同时保留整体对象；本行是六爻逐项审核单位，统计时不要把父子文本重复计为独立正文。
records.sourceDetail: Repository THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: preserved from natalengine 1.6.0 (MIT). Original author/primary doctrinal citation per sentence is not established; this is code provenance, not official HD endorsement.

textFields.text: At last the rain falls and the long restraint has done its work, so for now you may rest, since patient effort and steady character have reached their fullness. But the balance is fragile: the moon stands nearly full, and to press or assert yourself further from here invites misfortune.

usedBy: 闸门详情 I Ching Lens

textFields.text: Compute a chart and show the bodygraph. Human Design by default; add "gene_keys"/"astrology" to systems for those views. The bodygraph renders automatically as an inline visual panel (no action needed from you — do NOT also paste an image or SVG). The data comes back as JSON for you to interpret, plus an interactive-chart link you can offer. image defaults to "auto" (panel + link, ~zero extra tokens). Override only for non-visual clients: "svg" adds an SVG-artifact you must render verbatim, "png" adds a raster image block, "both" adds both, "none" is data + link only. Batches are cheap now — every chart gets its own free panel.

Center conditioning

Circuits

Every connecting channel runs through a circuit, which colours what the connection is about: Individual (mutation, uniqueness), Tribal (support, resources), Collective (sharing, logic), and Integration (self-empowerment).

        loc_lon = excluded.loc_lon,

textFields.text: 你拥有可持续的生命力。回应已经出现的事物，而非追逐尚未到来的事物，生活会运作得更顺畅。

textFields.text: 你拥有强劲而快速的能量，能同时投入许多事情。先回应，再告知会受到你行动影响的人。
